component_chashu.title: Braised pork chashu
steps: Roll the pork belly and tie it with kitchen string if you want to get regular slices; alternatively leave it lying.
Sauté the pig in a saucepan on all sides until the surface is well golden, then remove the excess fat.
Add water, soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, ginger and onion; it leads to light boiling.
Cover partially and let simmer 75 to 90 minutes, turning the piece every 20 minutes and adding little hot water if the bottom is reduced too much.
Turn off when the meat is tender but still sliced; let it cool in its water.
Cool at least 1 hour to compact the meat, then slice against fiber and briefly glaze the slices with a little bottom before serving.

component_ajitama.title: Ajitama / marinated eggs for ramen
steps: Bring to a boil a small pot of water and gently dip the eggs.
Bake 6 minutes and 30 seconds for a creamy yolk, then transfer them to water and ice immediately.
Shell the eggs when they are completely cold.
Mix soy sauce, mirin and water, pour the marinade into a small container and dip the eggs.
Marina in the fridge for at least 4 hours and not more than 24 hours, turning them in half time to color them evenly.

component_dashi.title: Dashi base kombu and katsuobushi
steps: Clean the kombu with a freshly moist cloth without washing away the surface patina.
Put kombu and water in the pot and let stand for 20 to 30 minutes.
Heat slowly and remove the kombu just before boiling.
Turn off the fire, add the katsuobushi and leave in infusion 2 minutes without stirring.
Filter through a fine strainer without squeezing and use the dashi immediately or cool it quickly.

component_tonkatsu.title: Pork tonkatsu

ingredients.name: Lonza or pork arista in slices of about 1.5 cm

steps: Slice the fat edge of the pork slices in several places to prevent them curling and beat them slightly to standardize the thickness.
Season with salt and pepper, then pass every slice into the flour eliminating the excess.
Dive into the beaten egg and cover with panko without pressing too much.
Heat the oil at 170...175°C and fry one cutlet at a time until the breading is golden and the pig is completely cooked but still juicy.
Drains on a grid for 2 to 3 minutes, then slices only at the time of assembly.

component_chocolate_custard.title: Chocolate cream for Choco Cornet
steps: Heat the milk until almost boiling.
In a bowl work egg yolks, sugar and starch until you get a smooth mixture.
Pour half the hot milk on the egg yolks stirring, then bring it back to the pan.
Cook over medium-low heat stirring continuously until the cream thickens and starts to simmer.
Remove from the heat, incorporate the chopped chocolate and mix until completely dissolved.
Cover in contact and cool completely in the refrigerator before filling the cornets.

component_brioche_cornet.title: Brioche dough for Choco Cornet
steps: Mix flour, sugar and yeast; add milk and egg and knead until dry flour remains.
Combine salt and butter little by little and keep kneading until the mass is smooth, elastic and comes off the top.
Cover and let rise 60 to 90 minutes, until almost doubling.
Swell gently, divide into 6 pieces and let the dough relax 10 minutes before forming the cords.

recipes.title: Shio Ramen — salt-seasoned ramen with chashu and menma
recipes.description: Shio ramen gets its clean, savory flavor from a light chicken-and-dashi broth seasoned primarily with salt. Cook the fresh noodles separately so they stay springy, then assemble each bowl just before serving. Chashu pork, a halved marinated egg, seasoned bamboo shoots (menma), chives and nori provide contrasting textures. Keep the broth hot without boiling it after adding sesame oil; the noodles should spend as little time as possible sitting in the soup.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan, Naruto. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: In a small saucepan, warm the chicken broth with the dashi powder, cooking sake and salt, stirring until dissolved.
Stir in the sesame oil and keep the broth hot over very low heat without letting it boil.
Bring a large pot of unsalted water to a rolling boil.
Cook the fresh ramen noodles for about 2 minutes, keeping them firm to the bite.
Drain the noodles thoroughly, shaking the strainer to remove excess water.
Pour the hot broth into two ramen bowls.
Gently place the noodles in the center of each bowl, folding the strands into an even mound.
Arrange the chashu slices, halved marinated egg, menma and a generous sprinkling of chives alongside the noodles.
Tuck a sheet of nori against the rim of each bowl and serve immediately while hot.

recipes.title: Kare Pan — crispy fried Japanese curry buns
recipes.description: Kare Pan (Croccante Fried Curry Panino) combines 00 flour, dry beer yeast and sugar in a preparation in which filling and wrapping must arrive ready at the same time. The dough is processed and allowed to develop before being formed, stuffed and cooked according to the intended technique. The phases include frying, leavening and dough; the total time is about 110 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Black Butler (Kuroshitsuji), My Hero Academia. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Hot thick Japanese curry (prepared with potatoes, carrots and minced meat)

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, add flour, sugar and yeast, then add warm milk.
Knead for 5 minutes, then add salt and softened butter.
Work the dough until it is smooth and elastic.
Cover with a cloth and let rise for 1 hour until doubling.
Divide the leavened dough into 6 equal balls.
Spread each ball form a disc with a slightly thicker centre and thin edges.
Put a generous spoonful of cold dense curry in the middle of each disc.
Close the edges carefully by sealing them well and giving the classic oval shape to ellipses.
Pass every sandwich first into the beaten egg and then into the panko making it stick evenly.
Let the sandwiches rest for 15 minutes.
Heat the seed oil at 170°C.
Fry the Kare Pan 2-3 minutes per side until they become golden and super crispy.
Drains on absorbent paper and hot serviles.

recipes.title: Ebi Tendon — shrimp and vegetable tempura over rice with tentsuyu sauce
recipes.description: Ebi tendon is a Japanese rice bowl topped with crisp shrimp and vegetable tempura. Keep the batter icy cold and mix it only briefly: a few lumps help create a delicate, airy crust. The shrimp are scored so they stay straight when fried, while a warm tentsuyu sauce of dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar seasons the rice. Arrange everything just before serving to preserve the contrast between hot rice and crunchy tempura.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! (Shokugeki no Soma), Mob Psycho 100. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: fresh peeled shrimp, tails left on
vegetables of your choice (pumpkin, eggplant or shiso leaves)
ingredients.note: For example pumpkin, eggplant and shiso leaves, cut into pieces suitable for tempura.

ingredients.name: steamed white rice (sushi rice or another short-grain rice)

steps.instruction: In a saucepan, add the dashi broth, soy sauce, mirin and sugar.
Brings to a slight boil for 2 minutes so that the sugar melts and the alcohol of the mirin evapori.
Turn it off and keep it off.
Practice 3-4 small diagonal cuts on the belly of each shrimp and gently spread it out to prevent it from curling up during cooking.
Work the yolk slightly with ice water.
Mix the flour all at once and mix very little with the chopsticks (the batter must remain lumpy and very cold).
Heats abundant oil at 180°C.
Slightly infarina shrimps and vegetables, dip them in the cold batter and fry them for about 2-3 minutes until the tempura is golden and crispy.
Place the hot rice in the bowls (Donburi), sprinkle it with a spoonful of Tentsuyu sauce, stick over the shrimps and vegetables in tempura and add another thread of hot sauce before serving.

recipes.title: Hambagu — Japanese hamburger steak with demi-glace sauce
recipes.description: Hambagu (Hamburg Steak Japanese with Demi-Glace Sauce) enhances mixed minced meat (manzo and pork), finely chopped golden onion and panko (pangrattato) softened in 2 tablespoons of milk with a cooking that concentrates the surface and keeps the inside to the expected consistency. Sauce or icing are prepared separately and applied at the right time to not burn sugar or miso. The main techniques are steam cooking, roasting and stewing; they serve about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Spy x Family, Food Wars!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Panko (pangrattato) softened in 2 tablespoons of milk

steps.instruction: In a frying pan brown the chopped onion with a little oil until it becomes golden and soft, let it cool completely.
In a large bowl, mix the minced meat, the cooled onion, the softened panko in the milk, the egg, salt, pepper and a sprinkle of nutmeg.
It kneads vigorously by hand for 3-4 minutes until the mixture becomes compact and slightly sticky.
Divide the dough into two large oval meatballs.
Switch the dough from one hand to another to eliminate internal air bubbles.
Practice a slight pressure in the center of each burger with your thumb (it will prevent it from swelling excessively during cooking).
Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the hamburgers for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Add 2 tablespoons of water in the pan, cover immediately with the lid and let steam over low heat for 6-8 minutes.
Transfer the burgers to the dishes.
In the same pan with meat juices, combine butter, ketchup, tonkatsu sauce, water and sugar.
Boil for 2 minutes mixing until you get a shiny and dense sauce.
Add the hot sauce over the Hambagu and bring to the table with rice or vegetables.

recipes.title: Miso Nikomi Udon — udon noodles simmered in miso broth
recipes.description: Miso Nikomi Udon (Udon Stufati al Miso) is a recipe of noodles in which fresh or frozen noodles udon, intense dashi broth and mixed or red miso pasta (Aka Miso) are managed separately to control sapidity and consistency. The process first prepares the liquid component or sauce, then cooks the pasta and closes the bowl with the gaskets. Boiling and stewing are provided; the total time is about 30 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Yuru Camp△, Natsume Yuujinchou. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

ingredients.name: red or mixed miso paste (Aka Miso)
chicken breast cut into small pieces
fresh shiitake mushrooms engraved on a cross

steps.instruction: In a pot, in terracotta (Donabe) or in a pot with a thick bottom, add the dashi broth and the mirin.
Door to light boil.
Take a ladle of hot broth, melt the miso paste inside with a whisk or chopsticks, then add it back into the pot mixing well.
Combine the chicken buns, Shiitake mushrooms and tofu cubes in the broth.
Cook over medium heat for about 5-7 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Combine the noodles udon directly in the stewed boiling broth and cook for another 4-5 minutes to absorb the flavors of miso.
Gently break an egg in the center of each portion, turn off the fire and cover for 2 minutes allowing the egg white to repel while maintaining the creamy yolk.
Garnish with the fresh onion and bring to the table very hot directly from the pot.

recipes.title: Chirashizushi — festive sushi rice topped with fish and vegetables
recipes.description: Chirashizushi (Riso Sushi Festive garnished with Fish and Vegetables) uses rice for cooked sushi and seasoned with rice vinegar, sugar and salt (Sumeshi) to build a plate of rice in which base and condiments retain separate identities. The elements that require cooking or cooling are prepared first, while the final assembly defines proportions and consistency. The recipe takes frying, cooling and assembly and takes about 30 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Fruits Basket, Kimi ni Todoke. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: rice for cooked sushi and seasoned with rice vinegar
fresh salmon for sashimi in cubes
egg (to make the thin cottage kinhi tamago)

steps.instruction: Spread the rice for sushi seasoned and warmed inside a large bowl in wood or ceramics.
Work the eggs with a pinch of salt and sugar.
Cook a very thin frittatina in a pan, let it cool and cut into thin strips like tagliolini.
Cover the rice surface entirely with kinhi tamag omelette strips.
Artistically system to ray or mosaic the cubes of salmon, tuna, shrimp and cucumber slices.
Combine a few tablespoons of Ikura salmon eggs in the middle, dust with toasted sesame seeds and alga nori strips.
Bring to the table fresh accompanied by soy sauce and wasabi.

recipes.title: Kurogoma Dango — toasted black sesame dumplings
recipes.description: Kurogoma Dango (Dango al Sesamo Nero Toastato) works glutinous rice flour (Shiratamako or Mochiko), warm water and sugar with attention to the structure, not only sweetness. The sequence controls dough or cream, temperature and rest times so that the cake reaches the expected consistency before finishing. The main techniques are boiling, grill or plate and dough; considering the expectations it takes about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Gintama, Samurai Champloo. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: lukewarm water
ingredients.note: Add it gradually: the actual quantity depends on the absorption of rice flour.

steps.instruction: In a bowl, mix the gluten-free rice flour with sugar.
Combine the water flush by kneading with your fingers until a soft bread with a consistency similar to the earlobe is formed.
Divide the dough into 12 equal balls by rolling them between the palms of the hands.
Dive the balls into a pot of boiling water.
When they come up, let cook for another 2 minutes.
Drain immediately and immerse them in a bowl of water and ice to block the cooking and make them elastic.
In a saucepan, combine black sesame paste, sugar, soy sauce, mirin and water.
Heat on a sweet heat mixing for 2 minutes until the sauce becomes dark, velvety and fragrant.
Stick 3 balls of dango on each bamboo skewer.
Slightly grill the skewers on a non-stick pan for 1 minute per side, then nappa generously with the hot black sesame sauce before serving.

recipes.title: Hanami Dango — three-color spring rice dumplings
recipes.description: The preparation of Hanami Dango (Dango Tricolore della Primavera) revolves around glutinous rice flour (Shiratamako), silk tofu (Silken Tofu) and icing sugar and the precise management of the cake structure. The process separates the phases that develop volume, cooking or taken from those of rest and finish. The processes include boiling and dough; the total time, including expected, is about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba), Clannad. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: strawberry powder or 1 drop of natural pink colour (for pink dang)

steps.instruction: In a bowl, add the glutinous rice flour, sugar and silk tofu.
Hand knead until the tofu integrates completely creating a homogeneous and soft compound.
Divide the dough into 3 equal parts (about 80g each).
Leave the first white part.
Combine Matcha powder with the second part and knead until it becomes clear green.
Combine the strawberry powder/coloring to the third part and knead until it becomes pink confection.
Shape 4 balls from each cake of color (you will get 4 green balls, 4 white and 4 pink).
Bake the balls in boiling water divided by color (first white, then pink, finally green) for about 2-3 minutes since they come up to the surface.
Transfer them to frozen water.
Stick a green ball down on each bamboo skewer, a white ball in the middle and a pink ball on top.
Bring to the table at room temperature.

recipes.title: Asari no Sakamushi — sake-steamed clams with ginger
recipes.description: The preparation of Asari no Sakamushi (Vongole al Vapore con Sake e Zenzero) revolves around fresh clams (sprinkled in salted water), Japanese cooking sake and finely sliced garlic clove and to the control of their consistency. The marine component is cooked or assembled only for the necessary time, while sauce and accompaniments are ready in advance. The sequence includes the processes planned and takes about 15 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! (Shokugeki no Soma), Midnight Diner (Shinya Shokudo). These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Wash the clams thoroughly, already flushed under cold running water.
In a large pan with lid, dissolve half of the butter and add the sliced garlic and grated ginger.
Brown on a soft heat for 1 minute.
Add the clams in the pan and add the Japanese sake immediately.
Cover immediately with the lid and raise the flame on a live fire.
Cook for 3-4 minutes by shaking the pan every now and then until all clams open completely (unwrap the remaining ones closed).
Turn off the fire, add the remaining butter and a thread of soy sauce.
Mix gently to create a tasty and shiny broth.
Dust with plenty of fresh chives and bring to the table hot with its broth.

recipes.title: Castella — fluffy Japanese sponge cake
recipes.description: For Castella Cake (Pan di Spagna Sofficissimo Japanese), large eggs at room temperature, semolated sugar and flour for bread or flour 00 sieved are processed through a process in which temperature and consistency are decisive. The procedure clearly distinguishes preparation of the base, cooking or intake and stabilization phase, without shortening the rest. Baked, set up and dough are provided, for about 68 minutes total.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Si alza il vento (Studio Ghibli), Gintama. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: flour for bread or flour 00 sieved

steps.instruction: In a cup melt the honey in warm water with the mirin.
In a large bowl, mount the eggs with sugar using electric whips for at least 10-12 minutes.
As long as the compound becomes clear, foamy and triple in volume.
Add the honey mixture in the eggs mounted flush and mix at a low speed for 1 minute.
Slice the flour on the mixture in three shots, gently incorporating it from the bottom upwards with a spatula to not disassemble the dough.
Add the dough in a rectangular mold lined with baking paper.
Cook in the oven at 160°C in a static oven preheated for 35-40 minutes until the surface is golden and a toothpick comes out dry, freshly baked.
Brush the surface with a veil of honey, wrap the cake in the transparent film and let it rest in the fridge for a few hours: this passage will make the Castle incredibly humid, soft and fragrant.

recipes.title: Sapporo Miso Ramen
recipes.description: The success of Miso Ramen di Sapporo depends on the coordination of chicken broth (or pork), red miso (Aka Miso) and white miso (Shiro Miso) without leaving the noodles waiting. The broth or seasoning is adjusted before cooking the pasta and the assembly takes place immediately after. Among the techniques employed there are roasting, stewing and marinating, distributed over about 45 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! - Shokugeki no Soma, Ramen Daisuki Koizumi-san. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: In a large pot, heat the sesame oil and brown the chopped garlic, grated ginger and the ground pork meat on medium heat until the meat becomes golden and grated.
Combine sake and sugar.
Then it incorporates the red miso and the white miso vigorously amalgamating with a wooden spoon to to slightly toast the miso without burning it.
Slowly add the hot chicken broth, mixing well to completely dissolve the miso.
Boil over a sweet heat for 10-15 minutes to mix all flavors.
In a separate pan, skip the soy sprouts with a drop of sesame oil for 2 minutes while keeping them crispy.
Cook the fresh noodles in boiling water in plenty of boiling water, not salted, following the instructions of the package (about 2-3 minutes), then drain them thoroughly.
On the basis of each large bowl add the boiling broth with miso and meat.
Combine the drained noodles by making them stick in the center.

Place on one side the soy sprouts, the sweet corn, half a marinated egg, a nut of fresh malga butter in the center (typical of the tradition of Sapporo), a sprinkled onion and a sheet of Nori algae stuck on the edge of the bowl.
Bring to the table immediately hot!

recipes.title: Kurogoma Nabe — black sesame pork hotpot
recipes.description: Kurogoma Nabe (Studo di Maiale al Sesamo Nero) develops the broth around thin slices of pork belly (or linza), Chinese cabbage (Hakusai) cut into 4 cm pieces and silky or firm tofu (cut into cubes), added at different times to respect its cooking times. The preparation proceeds by layers, adjusting sapidity and consistency while the liquid is enriched without causing the ingredients to fade. The main techniques are boiling and assembling; it takes about 30 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Yuru Camp△, Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: thin slices of pork belly (or linza)
Chinese cabbage (Hakusai) cut into 4 cm pieces
silky or firm tofu (cut into cubes)

steps.instruction: Clean vegetables and mushrooms.
Cut the Chinese cabbage into medium-sized pieces and the Shiitake mushrooms by making a cross incision on the chapel.
In a bowl, melt the black sesame paste with miso, mirin and soy sauce, adding a ladle of hot dashi broth until you get a fluid and homogeneous mixture.
In a pot, of terracotta (or large saucepan), it radiates the leaves of Chinese cabbage, tofu, Enoki mushrooms and Shiitakes.
In the middle place the slices of pork belly rolled slightly.
Add the remaining Dashi broth and black sesame mixture over the ingredients.
Cover with the lid and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Continue cooking for about 10-12 minutes until the meat is completely cooked and the vegetables are not tender but fragrant.
Bring to the table directly on the table keeping the pot warm!

recipes.title: Tenshinhan — crab omelet over rice with sweet-and-sour sauce
recipes.description: In Tenshinhan (Granky Omelette on Rice with Agrodolce Sauce), white Japanese steamed rice (Gohan), large fresh eggs and crab pulp or frayed Surimi are prepared and cooked according to a precise sequence, without combining passages that have different functions. The final seasoning comes only when the main part is ready. The techniques provided are boiled and set; the total duration is about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Dragon Ball, Food Wars! - Shokugeki no Soma. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: corn starch dissolved in 2 tablespoons of water

steps.instruction: In a saucepan, add chicken broth, soy sauce, sugar, rice vinegar and oyster sauce.
Bring to light boiling over medium heat, then add the melted cornstarch and mix continuously until you get a shiny sauce, thickened and velvety, keep warm.
In a bowl, work the 4 eggs slightly with a pinch of salt, pepper, sesame oil, frayed crab pulp and half of the onions.
Warm up a large amount of oil in a non-stick pan over a lively heat.
Add half of the egg mixture for each portion.
Continue cooking for 1 minute by moving the pan so that the base is represented but the top remains incredibly creamy and soft.
Place the golden omelet over a mountain of hot rice placed in the middle of a bottom dish.
Plenty nappa the omelet with the Ankake sweet and sour sauce well warm and garnish with the remaining onions.

recipes.title: Menchi Katsu — crispy minced-meat cutlets
recipes.description: Menchi Katsu (Croccante Carne Macinata Cottage) focuses on the contrast between crispy coating and properly cooked interior, starting from mixed minced meat (manzo and pork), finely chopped blonde onion and egg. Piece size, drying and oil temperature are prepared before frying, so the cover adheres without absorbing fat unnecessarily. The recipe uses frying, roasting and cooling and takes about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Isekai Shokudo - Restaurant to Another World, Persona 5. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: In a small pan brown the chopped onion with a drop of oil until it becomes transparent and golden, let cool completely.
In a large bowl, add minced meat, cold onion, egg, breadcrumbs softened in milk, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
It kneads vigorously by hand until the mixture becomes sticky and homogeneous.
Divide the dough into 4 oval portions.
Pass the meat from one hand to another by gently slamming it to eliminate any internal air bubbles that would break the cutlet during cooking.
Pass each schnitzel first into the flour, then into the beaten egg and finally cover it generously with Panko pressing lightly with your fingers to make the crumbs stick well.
Heats plenty of oil to fry at 170°C.
Fry the Menchi Katsu for 5-6 minutes per side on medium-low heat until the crust is dark and golden and the inside is well cooked and juicy.
Drain on absorbent paper and bring to the table hot accompanied by fresh cabbage and Tonkatsu sauce.

recipes.title: Shogayaki — ginger-glazed pork loin
recipes.description: For Shogayaki (Lombata di Maiale allo Ginger), thin slices of loin or pork belly, flour (to dust slightly) and fresh grated ginger are prepared before lighting the fire so as to control well gilding and seasoning. The finishing sauce enters when the main part is almost ready and can adhere without drying. The sequence uses stewing, setting and boiling, for a total of about 20 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Cooking Papa, Food Wars! - Shokugeki no Soma. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: thin slices of loin or pork belly

steps.instruction: In a small bowl mix the grated ginger with its juice, soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar until it completely melts.
Spread the slices of pork on a cutting board and dust them slightly with a veil of flour on both sides (this will allow the sauce to thicken and adhere perfectly to the meat).
Heat a spoonful of seed oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the pork slices for about 1.5 to 2 minutes per side until they are golden.
Add the ginger sauce directly above the meat in the hot pan.
Boil for 1 minute by stirring the pan until the sauce is reduced to a shiny and fragrant frosting.
Set up the pig side by side with an abundant mountain of fresh hooded cabbage and mayonnaise Kewpie, serving it with bowls of warm white rice.

recipes.title: Mabo Nasu — stir-fried eggplant with miso and minced meat
recipes.description: In Mabo Nasu (Melanzane Salted with Miso and Meat), eggplant beads or Japanese (cut into 5 cm sticks), minced pork meat and garlic clove are prepared and cooked according to a precise sequence, without combining passages that have different functions. The final seasoning comes only when the main part is ready. The expected techniques are boiling and roasting; the total duration is about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! - Shokugeki no Soma, Cooking Master Boy. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Eggplant beads or Japanese beads (cut into 5 cm sticks)
miso paste (or Doubanjiang for spicy version)
corn starch dissolved in little water

steps.instruction: Cut the eggplant into sticks and brown in a pan with 2 tablespoons of seed oil over medium heat for 5-6 minutes until golden and soft.
Remove them and save them.
In the same pan, add garlic, ginger and minced meat.
It browns the meat until it changes color and releases its juices.
Combine miso, soy sauce, sake and sugar by mixing for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring it back to a boil.
Combine the golden eggplant in the pan, mix gently to absorb the flavors for 2 minutes.
Then add the melted cornstarch together until you get a thick and enveloping sauce.
Dust with fresh onion and bring on the table a bowl of hot rice.

recipes.title: Monjayaki — Tokyo-style griddled savory pancake
recipes.description: In Monjayaki (Traditional Plate of Tokyo), finely cut cabbage, seafood (gamberetti/calamari) or pork pieces and tenkasu (fried batter balls) are processed carefully to the surface: first the main part is prepared, then the seasoning is concentrated without exceeding with heat. The sequence uses grill or plate and completes the dish in about 20 minutes overall.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by K-On!, March Comes in Like a Lion. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: In a jug add Dashi broth, flour and Worcestershire sauce and whisk well.
The batter will be much more liquid than that of Okonomiyaki.
Add cabbage, sea meat/fruits and Tenkasu on an electric plate or large hot frying pan.
Cook by skipping the ingredients for 3 minutes.
With two spatolines it forms a large ring/volcano with the cabbage in the middle of the plate, leaving an empty hole in the middle.
Gently add the liquid batter to the center of the volcano in two shots, allowing it to thicken slightly before mixing all together.
Spread the mixture on the plate.
Continue cooking until the lower part creates a dark and crunchy crust.
You eat directly from the plate with small metal spatula (Hagashi)!

recipes.title: Custard Cream Dorayaki — Japanese pancakes with pastry cream
recipes.description: Dorayaki with Custard Cream (Variante alla Crema) works large eggs, sugar and honey with attention to the structure, not only sweetness. The sequence controls dough or cream, temperature and rest times so that the cake reaches the expected consistency before finishing. The main techniques are cooling, leavening and dough; considering the expectations it takes about 30 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Doraemon, Kimi no Na wa (Your Name). These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: Add it gradually to adjust the fluidity of the batter.

steps.instruction: Work the egg yolks with sugar and cornstarch.
Heat the milk with vanilla without boiling, then add it flush on the egg yolks mixing.
Put it back on the fire and let it thicken over low heat by always mixing.
Cool covered with contact film.
Work the eggs with sugar and honey until they become clear.
Melt the yeast in the water and add it to the eggs.
Slice the flour and incorporate it gently.
Place the dough in the fridge for 15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan slightly greased with oil and clean with absorbent paper.
Pour a ladle of dough and form an 8 cm disc.
When bubbles appear on the surface, turn and let cook for another 30 seconds.
Let the discs cool, put a generous spoonful of custard cream in the middle of a disc and close to sandwich by gently pressing the edges to seal it.

recipes.title: Baked Yuzu Cheesecake
recipes.description: The preparation of Yuzu Cheesecake (Cheesecake Cotta allo Yuzu) revolves around dry biscuits (digestive type), melted butter and spreadable cheese (Philadelphia type) softened and to the precise management of the cake structure. The process separates the phases that develop volume, cooking or take from those of rest and finish. The processes include baking and cooling; the total time, included, is about 325 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! - Shokugeki no Soma, Kaichou wa Maid-sama!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

steps.instruction: Finely chop the biscuits and combine them with melted butter.
Compact them on the bottom of a cake tin lined with baking paper and put in the fridge for 15 minutes.
In a bowl, cream cheese spread with sugar.
Mix the eggs one at a time and mix well.
Combine fresh cream, juice and Yuzu zest and finally sifted flour until the mixture is smooth and velvety.
Add the cream to the biscuit base.
Cook in a static oven preheated to 160°C for about 45-50 minutes (the centre must remain slightly flickering).
Let cool at room temperature and then rest in the fridge for at least 4 hours before serving decorating with thin slices of citrus.

recipes.title: Sakura Mochi — sweet rice cakes wrapped in salted cherry leaves
recipes.description: Sakura Mochi (Mochi con Foglia di Ciliegio Salata) starts from pink glutinous rice (Domyoji-ko or glutinous rice cooked with a drop of pink dye), sweet red bean paste (Anko) divided into 6 balls and cherry leaves in brine (rinsed and dried) and builds its consistency through successive steps instead of a simple mixing. Cooking, cooling or setting are performed at the indicated time and the finish comes only when the structure is stable. The recipe uses steam cooking and takes about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Demon Slayer (Mitsuri Kanroji), Kimi ni Todoke. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: pink glutinous rice (Domyoji-ko or cooked glutinous rice with a drop of pink dye)
sweet red bean paste (Anko) divided into 6 balls
Cherry leaves in brine (drained and dried)

steps.instruction: Mix the glutinous rice with water, sugar and a tiny drop of pink food colouring.
Steam or cook in the microwave for 6 minutes until the rice is tender and sticky.
Beat the hot rice slightly with a pestle in order to mix the grains while maintaining a grainy and visible consistency (Kansai style).
Divide pink rice into 6 equal portions.
With your hands moistened, flatten a portion of rice on the palm of your hand, put a ball of Anko in the middle and wrap the rice around it perfectly sealing it.
Wrap each Sakura Mochi with a leaf of salted cherry.
The contrast between the filling dessert and the aromatic savour of the leaf will give the authentic flavor of Japanese spring!

recipes.title: Tantanmen — spicy sesame ramen with minced meat
recipes.description: Tantanmen (Ramen Piccante al Sesamo e Carne Macinata) balances minced pork meat, sesame oil and chopped garlic clove in a bowl built for phases. Broth or seasoning are prepared first, noodles remain separated until the right moment and the seals enter only in the final assembly. The main processes are boiling, roasting and assembly, for about 45 minutes overall.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! (Shokugeki no Soma), Ramen Daisuki Koizumi-san. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

ingredients.name: black or white sesame paste (Black Goma or Tahina)

steps.instruction: In a pan heats sesame oil, browns the chopped garlic and ginger.
Combine the minced pork and let it cook over a live heat by stretching it with a wooden spoon.
Combine spicy pasta, soy sauce and sugar.
Cook until the meat becomes golden and crispy, set aside.
In the two bowls from ramen, divide equally sesame paste, soy sauce and Rayu spicy oil.
Mix well at the bottom of each bowl.
Put in a saucepan, heat the chicken broth together with the soy milk without boiling it hard to prevent the milk from renneting.
Add the hot broth in the bowls and mix well with the whisk to dissolve the sesame paste on the bottom.
Bake ramen noodles in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain thoroughly and place them in the broth.
Garnish in the center with a generous spoonful of spicy meat, the boiled bok choy leaves and a sprinkle of chopped fresh onion.

recipes.title: Classic Griddled Yakisoba
recipes.description: In the Yakisoba Classica alla Piastra, pre-cooked noodles for Yakisoba (Mushi Chukamen), thin-sliced pork belly and hood cut into strips have distinct roles and are gathered only at the service. The pasta is cooked at the moment, while aromatic base and topping are ready in advance to avoid waiting for it to change consistency. The sequence includes steam cooking and grill or plate and takes about 30 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by My Hero Academia, Food Wars!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

steps.instruction: In a small bowl mix the Worcestershire sauce, the oyster sauce, the soy sauce, ketchup and sugar until they blend.
Heat a non-stick plate or a wok with a little oil.
Cook the pork belly in small pieces until it becomes slightly crispy.
Combine the onion, carrots and cabbage.
Skip on a lively heat for 3-4 minutes while keeping the crispy vegetables.
Rinse the noodles under hot water to rub them, then join them in a pan together with 2 tablespoons of water.
Cover with a lid for 1 minute to vaporize.
Add the Yakisoba sauce prepared above the noodles and vegetables.
Jump and mix vigorously over high heat for 2 minutes until the sauce candy slightly.
Serve hot garning with Aonori, Beni Shoga and Katsuobushi bows.

recipes.title: Pork Kakuni — soy- and ginger-braised pork belly
recipes.description: To obtain Pork Kakuni (Bean of Pig Stufata with Ginger and Soy Sauce), whole pork belly (with rind), slices of fresh ginger and onion (only green part) are processed in several phases: first the structure of the dough is built, then the piece is formed and the filling is inserted or completed. The sequence includes baking, stewing and boiling and respects all the necessary expectations, for about 120 minutes overall.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan, Food Wars!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Cut the pork belly into large cubes from about 4-5 cm.
In a pot, large put the pig, cover with water, join the ginger and green onions.
Boil over low heat for 45 minutes to remove excess fat.
Drain it and rinse it under warm water.
In the clean pot add 400ml of water, Sake, Mirin, soy sauce and sugar, bring to a boil.
Combine boiled pork cubes, cover with an Otoshibuta (or a baking paper disc) and cook over very low heat for another 40 minutes until the meat is incredibly tender and soft.
Add the boiled eggs peeled in the pot in the last 15 minutes of cooking to make them flavor in the brown background.
Place the tender pork cubes and the egg cut in half in the bottom plates, nappa with the bottom of the cooking and accompany with a pinch of mustard Karashi.

recipes.title: Traditional Winter Oden
recipes.description: In the traditional Oden Winter, dashi broth, light soy sauce (Usukuchi) and Mirin are prepared and cooked according to a precise sequence, without combining passages that have different functions. The final seasoning comes only when the main part is ready. The techniques provided are boiling and stewing; the overall duration is about 117 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Gintama, One Piece. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: bald daikon and cut into thick discs

steps.instruction: Cut the Daikon into 2.5 cm thick slices, insert a cross on one side (to facilitate cooking) and boil it in rice water for 15 minutes.
It also boils the Konnyaku triangles for 2 minutes to eliminate the smell.
In a large pot from Oden (Donabe or large pot), add Dashi broth, light soy sauce, Mirin and salt.
It's hot on medium heat.
Place the boiled Daikon, Konnyaku, boiled eggs and fish pies in the pot.
Lets simmer over very low heat for at least 45-60 minutes without ever boiling strong.
Combine Kinchaku bundles in the last 10 minutes to soften the mochi inside without breaking them.
Serve very hot in the middle of the table by picking the ingredients with broth and accompanying with mustard Karashi.

recipes.title: Katsu Curry Udon — udon noodles with curry and breaded cutlet
recipes.description: Katsu Curry Udon puts in balance pork Tonkatsu cutlets ready and breaded in panko, fresh or frozen Udon noodles and sliced onion in a bowl built for stages. Soup or dressing are prepared first, the noodles remain separated until the right moment and the seals enter only in the final assembly. The main processes are frying, boiling and assembly, for about 50 minutes overall.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Persona 5, Jujutsu Kaisen. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

ingredients.name: Tonkatsu pork cotlets ready and breaded in panko

steps.instruction: Fry the Tonkatsu schooner in abundant oil of hot seeds at 170°C until perfect gilding (about 5-6 minutes).
Drain it on absorbent paper and cut it into strips.
Put in a saucepan, fry the onion and carrot with a little oil.
Combine Dashi broth, soy sauce and Mirin.
Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Turn off the fire, combine the crumbled curry roux cubes and mix well with the whip until they completely melt creating a velvety and dense broth.
Cook the Udon in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain and divide them into two large bowls.
Add the thick broth to the boiling curry above the Udon.
Add the crunchy Tonkatsu schnitzel on the surface and garnish with plenty of fresh onion.

recipes.title: Agedashi Tofu — fried tofu in dashi broth
recipes.description: In the Agedashi Tofu (Tofu Fritto in Brodo Dashi), still tofu (Momen Tofu), corn starch (Katakuriko) and seed oil for frying are prepared and cooked according to a precise sequence, without combining passages that have different functions. The final seasoning comes only when the main part is ready. The expected techniques are frying, boiling and assembly; the total duration is about 34 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba), Spirited Away. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Wrap the tofu pan in kitchen paper and rest on a weight for 15 minutes to remove excess water.
Cut it to 4 or 6 large cubes.
In a saucepan, heat the Dashi broth with soy sauce, Mirin and sugar until it reaches a slight boil.
Turn it off and keep it warm.
Pass each cube of tofu into the cornstarch by sticking it evenly on all sides.
Fry in hot oil at 180°C for 3-4 minutes until the outer crust becomes white and crispy.
Place hot fried tofu cubes in individual bowls.
Gently add the hot broth around the tofu (without covering it entirely to avoid softening the crust).
Garnish the top of each cube with a grated Daikon bow, a pinch of ginger, onion and Katsuobushi flakes.

recipes.title: Unadon — grilled kabayaki eel over rice
recipes.description: The character of Unadon (Riso Bowl with Anguilla Kabayaki Grigliata) comes from the encounter between rice and grilled eel (Unagi Kabayaki, available frozen in Asian shops), steamed sushi rice and soy sauce, but each component follows first its own processing. Only at the end are seasoning and arrangement regulated, avoiding weighing the base. The main phases are baking, stewing and cooling and occupy about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Detective Conan. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: grilled eel (Unagi Kabayaki, available frozen in Asian shops)

steps.instruction: In a saucepan, add soy sauce, Mirin, Sake and sugar.
Boil over low heat for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens and becomes syrupy and shiny, if the eel is frozen, completely thaw it in the refrigerator.
Place the fillets on a baking sheet covered with baking paper.
Brush them with the Tare sauce and heat them in a ventilated oven or under the grill at 200°C for 6-8 minutes until the surface simmers and becomes caramelized.
Fill the bowls (Donburi) with hot white rice.
Taste the rice with a spoonful of warm Unagi Tare sauce.
Cut the eel fillets in half and lay gently over the rice.
Brush with another veil of sauce and dust with a pinch of Sansho aromatic pepper.

recipes.title: Ebi Chili — spicy tomato-ginger shrimp
recipes.description: The preparation of Ebi Chili (Gambers Salted in Spicy Sauce with Tomato and Ginger) revolves around large, clean shrimps, corn starch and egg whites and to the control of their consistency. The marine component is cooked or assembled only for the necessary time, while sauce and accompaniments are ready in advance. The sequence includes frying and boiling and takes about 33 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Cooking Master Boy. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Dry the shrimp well with kitchen paper.
In a bowl, mix the shrimp with the album, the Sake and the cornstarch.
Leave 10 minutes to rest.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the wok and skip shrimp for 1-2 minutes until they turn pink.
Remove them from the wok and save them.
In the same wok add a little oil, fry garlic, ginger and Doubanjiang spicy pasta over low heat until they release their aromas.
Add ketchup, chicken broth, soy sauce and sugar.
Bring to a boil, then add the dissolved starch in a spoonful of water to thicken the sauce.
Put the shrimp in a pan together with the chopped onion, jump for 1 minute to wrap them completely in the shiny and spicy sauce.
Serve immediately with white rice.

recipes.title: Kani Cream Korokke — creamy crab croquettes
recipes.description: The success of Kani Cream Korokke (Crocchette Cremose al Crachio) depends on how crab pulp (or Surimi finely chopped), onion finely chopped and butter are prepared before entering the oil. The coating must be uniform and the temperature stable, then the service follows quickly not to lose crunchiness. The preparation includes frying, cooling and assembly and lasts about 100 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Isekai Shokudo (Restaurant to Another World), Spy x Family. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: In a pan melt the butter and fry the onion over low heat without turning it golden.
Add flour and cook for 2 minutes by mixing (roux).
Add the hot milk to thread by mixing with the whip until you create a very thick and smooth béchamel cream.
Combine the crab pulp, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Add the mixture on a flat pan, cover with film and put in the fridge for at least 1 hour until it becomes solid and moldable.
With slightly oiled hands, divide the cold mixture into 8 oval portions.
Pass each croquette into the flour, then into the beaten egg and finally into the Panko making it stick well.
Fry in plenty of hot oil at 180°C for 3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain and agial on absorbent paper.
Serve with Tonkatsu sauce.

recipes.title: Sanma no Shioyaki — salt-grilled fish with daikon
recipes.description: Sanma no Shioyaki (Sales Grilled Sea Lace with Daikon) enhances fish Sanma (Sea Lace/Costardella) whole fresh, large sea salt and Daikon grated with a cooking that concentrates the surface and keeps the inside to the expected consistency. Sauce or icing are prepared separately and applied at the right time to not burn sugar or miso. The main techniques are baking, grill or plate and frame; it takes about 27 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan, Yuru Camp△. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Rinse the Sanma fish leaving them whole (the Japanese tradition includes cooking with the entrails for a pleasantly bitter taste).
Insert the skin with 3 diagonal cuts on each side.
Sprinkle generously with coarse salt and let 10 minutes rest.
Drys the moisture released by the salt with absorbent paper.
Cook the fish on a hot grill or on the oven plate at 220°C for about 6-7 minutes per side.
As long as the skin becomes golden, crispy and light burns form.
Place whole fish on elongated rectangular plates.
Come with a fresh, grated mountain of Daikon, lightly sprinkled with a drop of soy sauce and a clove of lemon.

recipes.title: Tamago Sando — fluffy Japanese egg sandwich
recipes.description: In the Tamago Sando (Sandwich Soft Japanese Egg), soft sandwich bread without crust (Shokupan), large and mayonnaise Japanese eggs (Kewpie) enter a sequence that gives first structure to the dough and only after it builds shape and filling. Expected expectations are not decorative: they serve to obtain a regular wrap and suitable for cooking. The recipe includes boiling and takes about 29 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Spy x Family, Detective Conan. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: soft bread for sandwiches without crust (Shokupan)

steps.instruction: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes to get a firm but creamy yolk.
Transfer them immediately into water and ice to block the cooking, then peel them.
Separate 1 egg and cut it in half (it will serve for the center of the sandwich).
Crush the other 3 eggs in a bowl with the fork, leaving some visible pieces.
Add Kewpie mayonnaise, milk, sugar, a pinch of salt and pepper to the dough of eggs.
Mix well until you get a spreadable consistency.
Spread a veil of soft butter on the slices of bread.
Place half a hard-boiled egg in the middle of the slice and cover generously with the mixture of crushed eggs.
Cover with the second slice of bread.
Slightly press the sandwich, then wrap it in film for 5 minutes.
Cut it in half exactly in the middle of the egg to reveal the decorative section.

recipes.title: Mizutaki Nabe — Hakata-style chicken and vegetable hotpot
recipes.description: In Mizutaki Nabe (Pollo stew and Hakata vegetables), chicken thighs with bone and skin, chicken wings with bone and water are cooked progressively so that each element maintains a recognizable consistency in the broth. The bottom is built and corrected during cooking, not only at the end. The recipe uses boiling and requires a total of about 65 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Yuru Camp△, Golden Kamuy. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs with bone and skin
chicken wings with bone
ingredients.note: Editorial quantity completed to make the meat/broth ratio repeatable.

steps.instruction: In a pot, Nabe (or large pot) put the water, the Kombu algae and the pieces of chicken with the bone.
Brings to slow boiling over medium heat constantly eliminating the foam on the surface with a skimmer to obtain a clear and rich broth.
After 20 minutes remove the Kombu algae, add the Sake and let the chicken cook for another 15 minutes until the meat becomes tender and the white opalescent broth.
Combine the Chinese cabbage cut into pieces, the Shiitake mushrooms inscribed to a star, the onions and the cube tofu.
Cook for 8-10 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Put the pot in the middle of the table.
Each diner picks up pieces of chicken and vegetables by dipping them in the fresh Ponzu sauce.

recipes.title: Tsukemen — dipping ramen with concentrated broth
recipes.description: In the Tsukemen (Ramen with Brodo Concentrato da Intingolo), thick noodles for Tsukemen or Ramen, slices of pork Chashu meat and Ajitsuke Tamago marinated eggs have different roles and are gathered only at the service. The pasta is cooked at the moment, while aromatic base and topping are ready in advance to avoid waiting for it to change its consistency. The sequence includes stewing, marinating and boiling and takes about 70 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Ramen Daisuki Koizumi-san, Food Wars!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: thick noodles for Tsukemen or Ramen

steps.instruction: In a saucepan, reduce the pork and chicken broth and let it simmer until it becomes very dense and tasty.
Combine soy sauce, Mirin, rice vinegar, spicy oil and Katsuobushi fish powder to give an intense umami boost.
Cook the thick noodles in plenty of boiling water for the time indicated on the package (usually 5-6 minutes).
Drain the noodles and rinse them immediately under running cold water and ice by working them with your hands to remove the surface starch and make them extremely elastic and firm, drain them well.
Place cold noodles on a plate or bamboo basket with over the Chashu, the marinated egg in half and the Nori leaf.
Add the boiling broth and concentrate in a separate bowl.
Take a lock of cold noodles with chopsticks, dip it in the concentrated boiling broth and taste it immediately.

recipes.title: Chicken Namban — Japanese fried chicken with tartar sauce
recipes.description: Chicken Namban (Fried Chicken with Japanese Tartara Sauce) starts from breast or chicken thigh without skin, flour 00 and egg beaten to bread and build its consistency through successive steps instead of a simple mixing. Cooking, cooling or setting are performed at the indicated time and the finish comes only when the structure is stable. The recipe uses frying, boiling and assembly and takes about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Isekai Izakaya Nobu. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: chicken breast or upper thigh without skin

steps.instruction: In a bowl, crush the boiled egg with the fork; add the Kewpie mayonnaise, chopped onion, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Amalgam and keep it cool.
In a saucepan, heat the soy sauce, rice vinegar and sugar until the sugar melts.
Add the sauce to a large baking dish.
Cut the chicken into big treats.
Slightly infarinate it, then pass it into the beaten egg.
Fry in seed oil at 170°C for 5-6 minutes until golden.
Take the freshly fried hot chicken and immerse it immediately in the sweet sauce Namban-zu for 1 minute, turning it on both sides to absorb the acid-sweet seasoning.
Place the chicken in the dishes and cover the surface with a generous spoonful of creamy tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Warabi Mochi — translucent sweets with kinako and kuromitsu
recipes.description: Warabi Mochi (Transparent Mochi with Kinako and Kuromitsu) works Warabimochi flour (or tajolica/potato starch), sugar and water with attention to the structure, not only sweetness. The sequence controls dough or cream, temperature and rest times so that the cake reaches the expected consistency before finishing. The main techniques are cooling and assembly; considering the expectations it takes about 20 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Demon Slayer, Samurai Champloo. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Put Warabimochi flour, sugar and water in a non-stick saucepan until the starch melts completely without lumps.
Put the saucepan on medium-low heat and mix continuously with a silicone spatula.
The mixture will pass from opaque white liquid to a transparent, glossy and very elastic gelled mass (about 5-7 minutes).
Prepare a large bowl with water and ice cubes.
Transfer the hot gelatinous mixture to a spoonful of ice water to make it firm and cool instantly.
Break or cut the cold gelatinous mixture into translucent cubes with your hands directly into cold water.
Drain the cubes of Warabi Mochi, place them on the saucers and dust thoroughly with Kinako flour and flows of sweet Kuromitsu syrup.

recipes.title: Japanese Soufflé Pancakes — tall and fluffy pancakes
recipes.description: The preparation of Japanese Soufflé Pancakes (Altissimi Pancakes and Softies) revolves around egg yolks, fresh and cold egg whites and whole milk and the precise management of the cake structure. The process separates the phases that develop volume, cooking or taken from those of rest and finish. The processes include leavening and frame; the total time, included, is about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Kaguya-sama: Love is War. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: In a bowl, work the egg yolks with milk and vanilla.
Sift the flour and yeast and add them to the egg yolks mixing until a smooth batter is obtained.
In a very clean bowl, mount the egg whites with the electric whips, adding sugar in three shots until you get a shiny and stable meringue, with firm but not dry peaks.
Embed 1/3 of the meringue into the egg yolks batter with the spatula to soften it.
Then add the rest of the meringue by gently amalgamating from the bottom upwards so that the mixture is not disassembled.
Grease a non-stick pan with a little butter over very low heat.
Create high batter hills.
Add 1 teaspoon of water to the bottom of the pan and cover immediately with a high lid.
Cook for 5-6 minutes on minimum heat.
Add a second layer of batter over the pancakes, cover and cook another 2 minutes.
Gently turn the pancakes, add another teaspoon of water, cover and cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve immediately hot and soft sprinkled with icing sugar and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Mont Blanc Chestnut Cake
recipes.description: Mont Blanc Chestnut Cake (Torta Mont Blanc alle Castagne) works discs of sponge bread or round meringue ready, fresh cream to be assembled and icing sugar with attention to the structure, not only to the sweetness. The sequence controls dough or cream, temperature and rest times so that the cake reaches the expected consistency before the finish. The main techniques are frame and assembly; considering the expectations it takes about 60 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, K-On!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: ready-made spanish or round meringue discs
chestnuts in syrup (Kuri no Kanrooni) for the top

steps.instruction: In a bowl, work the chestnut cream with soft butter and rum with the electric whip until it becomes velvety and free of lumps.
Pass it through a fine sieve to ensure fluidity in cream spaghetti.
Place the sponge bread or meringue discs on the saucers.
Place in the center of each disc a whole chestnut in syrup.
Cover the chestnut by creating a mountain / high cupola of whipped cream using a spatula.
Insert the chestnut cream into a sac-à-poche with a multi-hole nozzle (mouth for Mont Blanc/spaghetti).
Squeeze the chestnut cream all around the whipped cream dome creating overlapping threads to cover it entirely.
Dust the top with icing sugar to simulate the snow and lay a chestnut in syrup on top.

recipes.title: Fruit Sando — fresh fruit and whipped cream sandwiches
recipes.description: Fruit Sando (Sandwich with Fresh Fruit and Cream) requires to handle separately dough and filling before assembly.Shokupan soft sandwich bread, fresh liquid cream to be assembled very cold and semolated sugar are the main references of a process that goes from mass development to forming and cooking, with frame and assembly. From the beginning to the service it takes about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Cardcaptor Sakura, Horimiya. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: fresh liquid cream to be mounted very cold
Cherries or grapes without seeds
ingredients.note: Choose one of the two fruits according to the season.

steps.instruction: Mount the cold cream with sugar and vanilla until it becomes firm and structured.
Spread a generous layer of whipped cream on two slices of bread.
Place the whole fresh fruit over the cream following the diagonal line along which you will cut the sandwich (e.g.
It adapts strawberries oriented so that at the cut they show the heart section).
Cover the empty spaces between the fruit with other whipped cream so as not to leave any air gaps.
Close with the other slices of bread.
Wrap the sandwiches tightly in the transparent film and mark the diagonal cut line with a marker.
Leave in the fridge for 20 minutes.
Cut in half with a sharp knife following the line to show the fruit design.

recipes.title: Botamochi / Ohagi — glutinous rice sweets with anko
recipes.description: Botamochi / Ohagi (Glutinous Rice Mochi with Anko) works glutinous rice for sweets (Mochigome), rice for normal sushi (Koshihikari) and red bean jam Anko (Anko crushed/Tsubuan) with attention to the structure, not only to the sweetness. Cook in the cooker or in a pot with 280ml of water for 15 minutes from the boil.
Leave to rest covered for 10 minutes.

With a wooden pestle (Kine) or a spoon, it crushes the hot rice in the pot until the grains are partially discarded and the mixture becomes sticky and compact (without reducing it completely to mashed potatoes).
Divide rice into 6 oval portions with moist hands.

Serve at room temperature.

steps.instruction: Prepare the altar: in a saucepan heats soy sauce, mirin, ginger and garlic for 3 minutes over low heat, then filter.
Heat the chicken broth or dashi until lightly boil and keep it ready without making it reduce excessively.
Prepare the topping before the noodles: slice the chashu, cut in half the jitama, chop the onion and portion narutomaki and nori.
Pour the tarare on the bottom of two preheated ramen bowls and add the boiling broth, stirring to evenly distribute the seasoning.

recipes.description: For Takikomi Gohan, short-grained Japanese rice, dishi broth and diced chicken breast are processed in order to gradually build flavor and consistency. steps.instruction: Rinse rice in several waters until the water becomes almost clear, then drain for 15 minutes: rest prevents the bottom from becoming sticky during cooking.
Slice the rehydrated shiitakes, the carrot and l'aburaage; cut the chicken into uniform dice of about 1,5 cm.
Pour the rice into the pot or cooker and add dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sake, respecting the level of liquid provided for rice.
Distribute chicken, shiitake, carrot and aburaage on top without mixing: the ingredients will steam while the rice absorbs the seasoning.
Brings to a light boil, covers, lowers to a minimum and cook for about 15 minutes without lifting the lid; in cooking use the normal cycle.
Turn off and let stand covered for 10 minutes, so the moisture is redistributed and the grains finish cooking.
It stretches from the bottom upwards with a spatula, gently incorporating the condiments without crushing the rice, and hot servants.

recipes.title: Moyashi Itame — stir-fried bean sprouts
recipes.description: Moyashi Itame combines fresh soy buds, pork bacon cut into strips and small carrot into thin sticks in a sequence that keeps separate preparation, cooking and finishing. The ingredients enter at the expected time and the seasoning is adjusted only after reaching the required consistency. The main techniques are browning; the overall time is about 15 minutes.

steps.instruction: Wash the soy sprouts in cold water, drain them very well and dry them: they must enter the pan almost dry to remain crunchy.
Cut bacon, carrot and onion into thin pieces and prepare soy sauce, granular dash, pepper and sesame oil next to the wok.
Heat the wok over high heat and brown the bacon without other fats until it releases part of its fat and gets color.
Add the carrot and salt it for about 1 minute, keeping the fire high.
Combine buds and onion and jump vigorously for about 2 minutes: the buds must soften just but keep biting.
Season with soy sauce and dashi, mix for a few seconds and turn off before water is formed on the bottom.
Complete with black pepper and sesame oil and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cheesy Katsudon — breaded cutlet and cheese rice bowl
recipes.description: Katsu Donburi al Formaggio uses ready-made Tonkatsu pork cutlets, cooked white rice and sliced blonde onion subtly to build a plate of rice in which base and condiments retain separate identities. ingredients.name: Tonkatsu pork cutlets already ready and sliced

steps.instruction: Prepare two bowls with the rice warm and keep the tonkatsu cutlets already cooked and cut into strips about 2 cm wide.
In a donburi sauce it simmers dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar; add the onion and cook 3-4 minutes until it becomes translucent.
Adage over the onion a sliced cutlet without submerging it completely, so the breading absorbs flavor but does not dissolve.
Just beat an egg leaving visible egg white and yolk and pour about two thirds around and over the cutlet.
Distribute half of the cheese, cover and cook 60-90 seconds; add the remaining egg and turn off when it is still soft and shiny.
Carefully slide the contents of the pan onto the hot rice without breaking the schooner.
Complete with residual cheese or chives and serve immediately, before the egg loses creaminess.

recipes.title: Ishikari Nabe — Hokkaido-style salmon hotpot
recipes.description: In Ishikari Nabe, fresh salmon slices, red or mixed miso and dashi broth are cooked progressively so that each element maintains a recognizable consistency in the broth. The bottom is built and corrected during cooking, not only at the end. The recipe uses boiling, stewing and assembly and requires a total of about 45 minutes.

steps.instruction: Check the salmon by removing any bones and cut it into bites; prepare potato, carrot, cabbage, tofu and mushrooms in pieces of similar size.
Bring the dashi to a light boil in the donabe or in a large saucepan and melt the miso in a bowl with a ladle of hot broth, then put it back in the pot.
Add potato and carrot and cook to simmer for about 8-10 minutes until they begin to soften.
Combine cabbage, tofu and mushrooms and continue for 3-4 minutes.
Place the salmon on the surface and cook 6-8 more minutes gently, without boiling violently so as not to break it.
Taste the broth and correct with a little miso dissolved apart if needed; avoid boiling for a long time after the addition of miso.
Turn off, add the butter to the center and serve the hot nabe directly from the pot.

ingredients.name: chicken chest cooked at low temperature

steps.instruction: Prepare in advance chicken, menma, egg stew and yuzu peel; bring to a boil a separate pot of water for noodles.
Heat the filtered chicken broth with salt and sake until a slight bite and taste: it must be clear, savoury but not aggressive.
Turn off the fire and incorporate yuzu juice and sesame oil only to the last, to preserve the citrus aromas.
Cook the noodles in boiling water according to the thickness, draining them when they are still elastic; shake them well to eliminate excess water.
Distribute noodles in preheated bowls and pour the yuzu broth immediately.
Add chicken, menme and half egg leaving a visible part of the noodles.
Complete with freshly grated yuzu peel and serve immediately, before the noodles continue to absorb broth.

recipes.title: Asari Clam Chowder — creamy clam soup
recipes.description: Asari Clam Chowder uses fresh asari (or veraci) clams, medium potato with small cubes and onion without covering the character with too long cooking. The process concentrates the most intense workings at the beginning and leaves seasoning and finishing to the final phase. The techniques include roasting; from the beginning to the service it takes about 35 minutes.

ingredients.name: fresh asary clams (or veracious clams) and purged clams

steps.instruction: Open the clams in a pan with sake and a lid on fire.
Separate the clams from the filtered broth and keep everything aside.
In a pot, melt the butter and brown the bacon with onion, carrot and potato for 5 minutes.
Dust with flour and mix well for 1 minute to toast.
Gradually add the liquid of the filtered clams, the milk and the cream and continue to mix until you reach a velvety consistency.
Cook for 12 minutes until the potatoes are kept.
Combine the clams open last, black pepper rule and bring to the diner accompanied by bread croutons.

recipes.title: Kakiage Tempura — crisp vegetable fritters
recipes.description: In Kakiage Tempura, thinly sliced onion, thin julienne carrot and chopped shrimps (optional) are prepared so that the frying is quick and uniform. Pastel or breading enter only when the pieces are ready and the oil has reached the expected temperature; after cooking it drains and is completed immediately. steps.instruction: Slice onion and carrot very thin and cut shrimp into small pieces; dry everything well and dust with a spoonful of flour.
Bring the oil to about 170°C in a deep pot and prepare a drizzling grill next door.
Beat the yolk into the frozen water and incorporate the flour with a few stirs: the batter must remain cold and slightly lumpy.
Pour only the amount of batter needed to bind vegetables and shrimps, without turning the mixture into a heavy dough.
Shape small piles on a skimmer or between two spoons and slide gently into the oil.
Fry a few kakiage at a time for 2-3 minutes per side, turning them once, until they are golden and light.
Drain on grill, room immediately and serve hot with tentsuyu or salt to the matcha.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki Don — teriyaki chicken rice bowl
recipes.description: In Chicken Teriyaki Don, deboned chicken over thighs with skin, cooked rice for donburi and soy sauce are processed carefully to the surface: first the main part is prepared, then the seasoning is concentrated without exceeding with heat. ingredients.name: bone-in chicken over thighs with skin

steps.instruction: Bucherella the chicken skin with a fork and brown it in a pan over medium heat starting from the side with the skin, without adding fat.
Cook for 6-7 minutes until the skin becomes golden and crispy, then turn the chicken and let cook for another 4 minutes.
Remove excess fat from the pan with cooking paper.
Mix the ingredients of the sauce teriyaki and add it to the pan with chicken.
Boil the sauce until it becomes shiny and frosted, constantly napping the chicken.
Cut the chicken into strips, place it on the hot rice, add the caramel sauce on top and complete with sesame and onion.

recipes.title: Anko Dango with Kinako — rice dumplings with sweet bean paste
recipes.description: Anko Dango with Kinako starts with glutinous rice flour (Shiratamako or Mochiko), warm water and anko red bean jam (smooth koshian) and builds its consistency through successive steps instead of a simple mixing. ingredients.name: toasted soya floura (kinako) mixed with 1 teaspoon sugar

steps.instruction: Pour the rice flour into a bowl and add the water little at a time, kneading until the mass is smooth and soft, similar to the ear lobe.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions and form compact balls without cracks.
Bring to a boil an abundant pot of water and dive the dangos without overloading it.
When the balls go up to the surface, continue cooking for another 2 minutes to cook well the center.
Transfer them immediately into water and ice to stop cooking; drain them and dry them gently.
Throw three dangos for each skewer and distribute over the smooth anko.
Mix kinako and sugar, dust the skewers just before serving and consume them daily to keep them soft.

recipes.title: Classic Japanese Curry Udon
recipes.description: The success of Japanese Curry Udon Classico depends on coordinating fresh or frozen noodles udon, Japanese curry roux already ready and dashi broth without leaving the noodles waiting. Meat rosola and onion in casserole for about 3 minutes, until the meat changes color and the onion begins to soften.
Add dash, soy sauce and mirin and bring to a boil for 3-4 minutes.
Turn off the fire, incorporate the curry roux little by little until it is completely melted, then rekindle over low heat.
Cook another 5 minutes stirring: the broth must veil the spoon but remain fluid enough to wrap the udon.
Cook the udons in separate water, drain them thoroughly and distribute them in the bowls.
Pour the boiling curry on the udon, complete with onion and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Yaki Onigiri — grilled rice balls with soy sauce and butter
recipes.description: Yaki Onigiri with Soy Sauce and Butter uses rice for hot baked sushi, soy sauce and mirin to build a plate of rice in which base and condiments retain separate identities. steps.instruction: Use freshly cooked rice but warm enough to be handled; moisten and slightly salt your hands.
Divide the rice into four portions and form compact triangles, pressing as much as necessary because they do not break during the grilling.
Mix soy sauce and mirin in a bowl and prepare a kitchen brush.
Melt half the butter in a non-stick pan and brown the oniri over medium heat for about 3 minutes per side, without moving them until a crust is formed.
Brush one side with the mixture of soy, turn and leave caramel for about 1 minute; repeat on the other side.
Add the remaining butter and turn the onigiri into the pan to distribute the scent without burning the sauce.
Complete with toasted sesame and hot servants, with dry crust and still soft center.

recipes.title: Dashimaki Tamago — rolled Japanese omelet with dashi
recipes.description: Dashi Maki Tamago uses large fresh eggs, cold dashi broth and mirin as the basis of a preparation scanned in separate passages. steps.instruction: In a bowl, gently beat the eggs with dashes, mirin, soy sauce and salt without assembling them.
Filter the mixture with a strainer to make it perfectly homogeneous.
Grease a rectangular frying pan (makiyakinabe) with absorbent paper soaked in oil over medium-low heat.
Add a thin layer of egg, have it retract slightly and roll towards you.
Place the roll on the bottom, grease the pan again and add another layer by pouring the egg under the roll.
Repeat the operation 4-5 times until the roll becomes high and stratified.
Model with a bamboo mat, cut into thick slices and bring to the table with grated daikons and soy sauce.

recipes.title: Layered Matcha Parfait
