waffles or pocky sticks to the matcha to garnish

steps.instruction: Prepare and cool in advance matcha and shiratama gelatin; mount the soft cream and keep the ice cream in the freezer until the last one.
Cut the gelatin into regular cubes and divide l'anko into two portions, so the layers will be balanced in the two glasses.
Put a thin layer of corn flakes on the bottom of the glasses, avoiding crushing them.
Add gelatin to the matcha, anko and a first spoonful of whipped cream, leaving the layers visible.
Repeat the layers if the height of the glass allows, without filling it completely.
Add an ice cream ball to the matcha only at the time of service.
Complete with shiratama, waffle or Pocky and a small tuft of cream; serve immediately so that the crispy part does not lose consistency.

recipes.title: Kabocha Korokke — Japanese pumpkin croquettes
recipes.description: Kabocha Korokke focuses on the contrast between crispy and properly cooked interior lining, starting from clean Japanese Kabocha (or Delica) pumpkin, ground pork or beef and finely chopped onion. steps.instruction: Cut the pumpkin into pieces and let it steam for 15 minutes until it becomes tender.
Then crush it with a potato crusher holding the skin and eliminating excess moisture.
Burn onion and minced meat in butter until well cooked and season with salt and pepper.
Add the meat to the pumpkin puree, mix well and let cool the dough.
Shape 6 oval and crushed croquettes.
Pass each croquette into the flour, then into the beaten egg and finally into the panko pressing well.
Fry in abundant hot oil at 170°C until full crispy gilding (about 3 minutes per side).
Serve hot with tonkatsu sauce.

recipes.title: Nerikiri — traditional Japanese wagashi sweets
recipes.description: For Nerikiri, shiroan (sweet white bean paste), Shiratamako rice flour and water are processed through a process in which temperature and consistency are decisive. The process clearly distinguishes preparation of the base, cooking or taking and stabilization phase, without shortening the rest. Cooling and dough are provided, for about 45 minutes total.

ingredients.name: Anko (red bean paste) for central filling

steps.instruction: Melt the shiratamako in the water until the lumps are removed, then incorporate it with the shiroan in a non-stick pan.
Cook over very low heat stirring and crushing the mixture until it loses moisture, becomes elastic and comes off the pan.
Transfer the dough onto a tray and work it several times as it cools to obtain a smooth and uniform mass.
Divide it into the necessary portions and color small parts with minimal amounts of dye, kneading until the dye is homogeneous.
Form four balls of anko from about 15 g each and keep them covered so that they do not dry out.
Flatten a portion of nerikiri, enclose the hole in the center and close the joint well on the bottom.
Model the surface with toothpick or wagashi tools to create petals and details, working with barely wet hands.
Keep covered and serve at room temperature with tea, preferably on the same day.

recipes.title: Yaki-Imo — Japanese roasted sweet potatoes
recipes.description: For Sweet Potato Yaki-Imo, Japanese sweet potatoes with purple/yellow paste (Satsumaimo) are prepared before lighting the fire so as to control well gilding and seasoning. ingredients.name: Japanese sweet potatoes with purple/yellow paste (Satsumaimo)

steps.instruction: Choose similar sizes, wash them carefully without peeling them and dry them well.
Bucherella the skin in some places with a toothpick to facilitate a uniform cooking.
For a creamier pulp, wrap each potato in freshly moist kitchen paper and then in aluminium; for a dry skin, use only aluminium.
Cook in a static oven at 180-190°C for about 60-75 minutes, turning the paperwork in half cooking.
Check by sticking a toothpick into the thickest point: it must enter without resistance and the pulp must be soft to the center.
Leave to stand closed in the paper for 5-10 minutes, so the steam completes the cooking.
Open, divide in half and serve hot; the salt is optional and should only be added to the service.

recipes.title: Ogura Toast — thick toast with sweet red bean paste
recipes.description: Ogura Toast combines thick bread for Japanese toast Shokupan, excellent quality butter at room temperature and red bean jam Ogura An (anko with whole grains) in a preparation in which wrapping and filling must arrive ready at the same time. ingredients.name: thick bread for Japanese toast Shokupan
excellent quality butter at room temperature
Ogura An red bean jam (anko with whole beans)

steps.instruction: Cut two slices of shokupan thick about 2"3 cm and bring l"ogura an to room temperature or just heat it, without letting it dry.
If the anko is very compact, soften it with a teaspoon of hot water and stir until it is creamy but not liquid.
Toast the bread on both sides until the surface is well golden and crispy while the center remains soft.
Sprinkle the butter on the still hot bread immediately, insisting also on the edges so that it is absorbed by the crumb.
Distribute l'ogura an in a generous and uniform layer, without crushing the bread.
If you use whipped cream, add it cold only after letting the toast cool for a minute, so it doesn't melt.
Diagonally cut and serve immediately, keeping the contrast between crispy crust, soft bread, butter and anko.

recipes.title: Tonkotsu Ramen — rich pork-bone broth ramen
recipes.description: The success of Tonkotsu Ramen (Ramen in Bronze Dense of Pig) depends on coordinating mixed pig bones (neck, femur or knuckle), cold water, more boiling water for the rabble and fresh ginger slices without leaving the noodles waiting. The broth or seasoning is adjusted before cooking the pasta and the assembly takes place immediately after. Among the techniques used there are boiling, distributed over about 442 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! (Shokugeki no Soma), Ramen Daisuki Koizumi-san. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

ingredients.name: mixed pig bones (neck, femur or knuckle)
cold water, plus boiling water for rackets

steps.instruction: Rinse the pig bones and leave them in cold water for 15-30 minutes, changing the water several times to remove blood and impurities.
Boil the bones 10 minutes, drain and rinse thoroughly; also clean the pot before starting the actual broth.
Cover the bones with fresh water, add garlic and ginger and bring to a vigorous boiling; foam the dark clots in the early stages.
Keep a firm boil for at least 5-6 hours, bubbling with boiling water when needed: fat and collagen must emulsify until the broth is opaque and full-bodied.
Filter the broth, put it back on the fire and adjust the concentration; prepare to partear, chashu, eggs, sprouts, onion, nori and mayu oil.
Bring to a boil a separate pot of water and cook the fresh noodles for the indicated time, usually 1-2 minutes; drain them very well.
Place the torre on the bottom of the preheated bowls, pour the boiling tonkotsu broth and mix.
Add the noodles and complete immediately with chashu, half ajitama, buds, onion, nori and a few drops of mayu.

recipes.title: Kurogoma Ice Cream — black sesame ice cream
recipes.description: Kurogoma Ice Cream (Gelato al Sesamo Nero) starts from black sesame paste (Neri Goma), fresh cream to be assembled and whole milk and builds its consistency through successive steps instead of a simple mixing. Cooking, cooling or setting are performed at the indicated time and the finish comes only when the structure is stable. The recipe uses cooling, freezing and frame and takes about 180 minutes.

steps.instruction: Mix milk, sugar and salt in a saucepan and heat them over medium heat until the sugar is completely dissolved, without boiling.
Embed the black sesame paste with a whisk until a uniform base is obtained without lumps.
It cools the mixture quickly, first at room temperature and then in the refrigerator until it is cold.
Mount the cream up to a soft consistency, not excessively firm.
It incorporates the cream at the base of sesame in two or three times with delicate movements, maintaining the airy compound.
With ice cream maker, keep until the consistency expected by the manufacturer and transfer to freezer to stabilize.
Without ice cream maker, freeze in a low container and mix vigorously every 30 minutes for about 2 hours, then let completely firm before serving.

recipes.title: Motsunabe — Fukuoka-style offal and leek hotpot
recipes.description: Motsunabe (Fukooka's stew and leeks) is a warm preparation based on tripe or clean beef/pig offal, cabbage hood and chives/Chinese leeks (Nira) and on an orderly cooking of ingredients. The sequence avoids putting everything together: the broth is gradually developed and the most delicate elements arrive later. Boiling, stewing and assembly are provided, for a total of about 45 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Golden Kamuy. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Trippe or offal of clean beef/pig

steps.instruction: Clean the offal thoroughly; rub them with salt and little flour, rinse them several times and cut them into regular bites.
Boil it for about 1 minute, drain and rinse: this phase eliminates impurities and part of the smell without melting the fat too much.
Prepare the broth with dash, garlic, chilli and miso or soy sauce, keeping it tasty because cabbage and tofu will dilute it.
Place the cabbage on the bottom of the nabe, add tofu and offal and pour the broth until you partially cover the ingredients.
Bring to the boil and cook the offal for about 10-15 minutes, until they become swollen and tender.
Add the nira cut into sticks in the last few minutes, without mixing too much.
Taste the broth, adjust the miso or soy and serve the boiling nabe directly from the pot.

recipes.title: Saba no Misoni — mackerel braised with miso and ginger
recipes.description: Saba no Misoni (Scombro Stufato al Miso e Ginzero) uses fresh mackerel, miso and mirin without covering the character with too long cooking. The process concentrates the most intense workings at the beginning and leaves seasoning and finishing to the final phase. The techniques include baking, boiling and assembly; from the beginning to the service it takes about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan, Cooking Papa. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Slightly insert the skin of the mackerel fillets and pour boiling water over it for a few seconds; drain and dry them to mitigate the most intense smell.
Cut the ginger into thin slices and prepare in a large pan water or dashi, sake, mirin and sugar.
Bring the liquid to a boil and add half the ginger.
Place the mackerel with the skin facing upwards, cover with an otoshibuta or perforated baking paper and cook over medium to low heat for about 8-10 minutes.
Take a ladle from the bottom, melt the miso and put it back in the pan without boiling it violently.
Continue napping the fillets with the bottom for 3-5 minutes, until the sauce becomes shiny and slightly dense.
Complete with the ginger left and serve immediately, with the skin intact and the meat still juicy.

recipes.title: Chashu Don — braised pork and egg rice bowl
recipes.description: Chashu Don (Rice Bowl with Brasato Pig and Egg) uses braised chashushu, chashu-sauce and Japanese rice cooked and hot to build a plate of rice in which base and condiments retain separate identities. The elements that require cooking or cooling are prepared first, while the final assembly defines proportions and consistency. The recipe uses stewing, cooling and assembly and takes about 20 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Naruto, Food Wars!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Japanese rice cooked and well warm

steps.instruction: Heat the chashu in a frying pan with a tablespoon of its soup sauce until the fat returns soft and the edges begin to caramelize.
If you use slices instead of cubes, doral quickly on both sides or pass them with the cinnamon to obtain a more aromatic surface.
Distribute the very hot rice into the bowls and season with some of the lard sauce.
Place the chashu over the rice without crowding it, so that every bite receives meat and sauce.
Cut the jitama in half and add it to the bowl.
Complete with sliced onion and, if expected, a small amount of mayonnaise Kewpie.
Serve immediately before the chashu's fat cools and repents.

recipes.title: Ebi Mayo — crispy shrimp in sweet-and-tangy mayo sauce
recipes.description: Ebi Mayo (Crossing Gambers in Mayonnaise Agrodolce Sauce) uses peeled and clean shrimps, egg whites and corn starch without covering the character with too long cookings. The process concentrates the most intense workings at the beginning and leaves seasoning and finishing to the final phase. The techniques include frying and grilling or plate; from the beginning to the service takes about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Isekai Izakaya Nobu. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Dry the shrimp well and practice a small cut on the back if necessary to remove the intestinal thread.
Mix Kewpie mayonnaise, condensed milk or honey and lemon juice until you get a smooth sauce; keep it aside at cool temperature.
It passes the shrimps into the album and then into the cornstarch, eliminating the excess to obtain a thin coating.
Bring the oil to about 170°C and fry a few shrimps at a time for 2-3 minutes, until they are just golden and cooked in the center.
Drain onto grid or absorbent paper and let them rest only a few seconds.
Condiscile still warm with the sauce Ebi Mayo, stirring gently to cover them without softening the crust too much.
Serve immediately, with lemon peel or onion as a finish.

recipes.title: Nagashi Somen — chilled summer somen noodles
recipes.description: The success of Nagashi Somen (Somen Cold Summers) depends on coordinating very thin noodles Somen, soup Mentsuyu cold of fridge and grated ginger without leaving the noodles waiting. The broth or seasoning is adjusted before cooking the pasta and the assembly takes place immediately after. Among the techniques employed there are boiling and cooling, distributed over about 15 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Non Non Biyori, Karakkai Jozu no Takagi-san. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Prepare the mentsuyu in advance and cool it well in the refrigerator; grate the ginger and slice the onion just before the service.
Bring to a boil abundant unsalted water and immerse the somen, separating them immediately with the chopsticks.
Cook them for about 90 seconds or according to the package: they must remain elastic and not disassemble.
Drains and washes under very cold running water, gently rubbing them with your hands to remove surface starch.
Transfer them to water and ice just to keep them cool, without leaving them immersed too long.
Serve small portions at a time and dip them in the cold mentsuyu with ginger, onion and sesame.
If you want to simulate the nagashi service, scroll the somen in very cold clean water and collect them immediately with chopsticks.

recipes.title: Classic Anmitsu — kanten jelly, fruit, anko and kuromitsu
recipes.description: Anmitsu Classico (Gelatin Kanten with Fruit, Anko and Kuromitsu) starts from kanten (agar-agar) in powder, water and Anko red bean jam and builds its consistency through successive steps instead of a simple mixing. Cooking, cooling or setting are performed at the indicated time and the finish comes only when the structure is stable. The recipe uses boiling, cooling and assembly and takes about 30 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Gintama, Demon Slayer. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: To dissolve and activate the kanten.

steps.instruction: Melt the kanten in cold water, bring to a boil and cook for about 2 minutes stirring until it is completely dispersed.
Pour the liquid into a low container, let cool and transfer to the refrigerator until complete gelling.
Cut the kanten gelatin into regular cubes and prepare the fruit by dripping it well.
If you use shiratama, cook until it floats, continue for 1-2 minutes and cool them in cold water.
Distribute kanten cubes into cups and add fruit and shiratama while keeping the different elements visible.
Add a portion of anko to the center.
Pour the kuromitsu only at the time of service, so jelly and fruit do not remain immersed too long.

recipes.title: Kinpira Gobo — sautéed burdock root and carrots
recipes.description: For Kimpira Gobo (Radici di Bardana e carroti Saltate), root of Gobo (bardana), carrot with match and sesame oil are processed in order to gradually build flavor and consistency. The procedure closes each phase before moving on to the next, avoiding cooking or pre-seasoning that would change the result. The recipe uses steam cooking and takes about 20 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan, Fruits Basket. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Wash and brush the bardana, cut it into a match and put it in the water immediately for about 5 minutes to limit oxidation and attenuate astringency.
Cut the carrot into sticks of the same size and drain the beard very well.
Heat sesame oil in a frying pan and burdock and carrot sauce over medium to high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Add sugar and mirin and mix until the sugar is dissolved and the vegetables start to icing.
Pour in the soy sauce and keep jumping until the liquid has almost evaporated.
Taste: the bardana must be cooked but still slightly crispy.
Complete with toasted sesame and togarashi shichimi and serve warm, warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Tori no Karaage Namban Don — fried chicken rice bowl
recipes.description: Tori no Karaage Namban Don (Ciotola di Pollo Fritto Namban) uses deboned, skinless chicken over thighs, soy sauce and cooking sake to build a plate of rice in which base and condiments retain separate identities. The elements that require cooking or cooling are prepared first, while the final assembly defines proportions and consistency. The recipe uses frying, grill or plate and cooling and takes about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, My Hero Academia. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Deboned chicken over thighs, without skin, with small mouthpieces

steps.instruction: Cut the chicken thighs into regular bites and dress them with soy sauce, sake, ginger and garlic; let marinate at least 20 minutes.
Prepare the Namban sauce bringing to light boiling soy sauce, rice vinegar, mirin and sugar, then let it warm.
Prepare the tartar by mixing chopped boiled egg, onion and pickle well drained, japanese mayonnaise, little vinegar, salt and pepper; keep it in the refrigerator.
Drain the chicken from marinade, pass it into potato or maize starch and shake the excess.
Fry at 170-175°C in small lots until the bites are golden and the chicken is completely cooked; drain on grill.
Immerse the karaage still warm in the namban sauce for a few seconds, so it absorbs the seasoning without completely losing the crispness.
Distribute hot rice and cabbage to julienne in the bowls, add the chicken namban and complete with the cold tartar sauce.
Serve immediately, keeping the contrast between hot rice, crispy chicken and fresh tartar.

recipes.title: Kakuni Udon — udon noodles with tender braised pork
recipes.description: Kakuni Udon (Udon with Pig Brasato Morbidissimo) is a recipe of noodles in which thick udon, complete kakuni and dashi are managed separately to control flavor and consistency. The process prepares first the liquid component or the sauce, then cooks the pasta and closes the bowl with the gaskets. Boiling, stewing and assembly are provided; the total time is about 50 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen, Food Wars!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Warm the kakuni gently in its bottom until the meat is soft and the fat is shiny again; do not boil it hard.
Bring the dashi to a boil and season with soy sauce and mirin, tasting before adding more salt.
In a separate pot cook the udon according to the package, then drain them very well.
Rinse the udon quickly only if required by the type used, then transfer them to the preheated bowls.
Pour the boiling broth on the udon and gently separate the threads with the chopsticks.
Add two pieces of kakuni per serving and add a spoon of the bottom of the lard to intensify the flavor.
Complete with onion and a small amount of karashi on the edge of the bowl and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Kenchinjiru — Buddhist-style vegetable, tofu and root soup
recipes.description: The character of Kenchinjiru (Vegetarian Buddhist Soup with Tofu and Roots) comes from the cooking of tofu firm crumbled, Daikon and carrot in a bottom that is built step by step. Time and order of addition prevent the most delicate components from losing structure. The processes include boiling and roasting; from the beginning to the service it takes about 30 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Demon Slayer, Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Drain the tofu and crumble it coarsely; cut daikon, carrot, gobo and shiitake into small and uniform pieces.
If you use fresh gobo, briefly put it in the water after cutting and then drain it well.
Heat sesame oil in casserole and brown before the roots and mushrooms for 3-4 minutes.
Add the tofu and mix gently to cover it with oil without reducing it to cream.
Pour the kombu dashi, bring to light boil and remove the foam that emerges.
Bake over low heat for about 15 minutes, until the roots are tender but not undone.
Season with sake and soy sauce, taste and serve hot; avoid katsuobushi if you want to keep the preparation strictly vegetarian.

recipes.title: Omusoba — yakisoba wrapped in an omelet
recipes.description: Yaki Soba Omelette (Omusoba) puts in complete yakisoba balance, eggs and milk in a bowl built for stages. Soup or condiment are prepared first, noodles remain separate until the right moment and the seals enter only in the final assembly. The main processes are frying and roasting, for about 25 minutes overall.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Ranma ½. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Slice cabbage and carrot, cut the pig into bites and separate the yakisoba noodles with your hands.
Heat a large pan, brown the pig and add carrot, cabbage and any sprouts; jump until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the noodles and a few tablespoons of water, cover for 1-2 minutes and then separate them completely.
Season with yakisoba sauce and skip until the bottom is dry and the noodles are well coated; put aside the heat.
Beat the eggs with milk and a pinch of salt, then cook in a clean frying pan a thin omelette still soft in the middle.
Place a portion of yakisoba in the center of the omelet, fold the edges and reverse on the plate with the closing down.
Complete with yakisoba sauce, Kewpie mayonnaise and aonori; add shoga or katsuobushi goods if expected.
Serve immediately before the omelet dries.

recipes.title: Japanese Soufflé Cheesecake — cotton-soft cheesecake
recipes.description: For Soufflé Cheesecake (Cotton Cheesecake), spreadable cheese, egg (albumen and separate egg yolks) and sugar are processed through a process in which temperature and consistency are decisive. The process clearly distinguishes preparation of the base, cooking or grip and stabilization phase, without shortening the rest. Baking, cooling and mounting are provided, for about 120 minutes total.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, K-On!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: egg (separate egg yolks and egg yolks)

steps.instruction: Dress the mold and prepare a larger baking tray for the water bath; preheat the oven to 150-160°C.
Melt in a bainmaria cheese spreadable, butter and milk until the mixture is smooth, then let cool.
Embed the egg yolks one at a time and add sifted flour and starch, stirring only until the lumps are removed.
Mount the egg whites and add sugar in several shots until you get a shiny meringue with soft-medium peaks, not excessively rigid.
Embed a third of the meringue at the base to lighten it, then join the rest with movements from bottom to top.
Pour into the mold, remove the larger bubbles with small blows and place the mold in the hot water bath.
Cook for about 60 minutes, adjusting the heat if the surface darkens too much; the center must be cooked but still elastic.
Turn off the oven and let the cake stand with the open door open for 10-15 minutes, then deform and cool it completely before cutting.

recipes.title: Suika Shiratama — watermelon with rice dumplings and lemon syrup
recipes.description: The preparation of Suika Shiratama (Summer Watermelon with Rice Mochi and Lemon Syrup) revolves around fresh watermelon with ice cubes, Mochi Shiratama balls and seltz or lemon soda and precise management of the cake structure. The process separates the phases that develop volume, cooking or take from those of rest and finish. The processes include cooling, dough and boiling; the total time, included, is about 20 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Grand Blue, Free!. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Seltz or lemon soda
ingredients.note: Use a cold drink; the lemon soda makes the dessert sweeter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the shiratamas by mixing glutinous rice flour and water little at a time until you get a soft and modelable dough.
It forms small balls, cook them in boiling water until they come up to the surface and continue for 1-2 minutes; immediately cool them in water and ice.
Cut the watermelon into cubes or small balls, remove the seeds and cool it in the refrigerator.
Drain the shiratamas and dry them slightly so that the drink is not diluted.
Distribute watermelon and shiratama in very cold glasses.
Add cold seltz or a transparent lemon drink only at the time of service.
Serve immediately with a teaspoon or wide straw; keep the dessert cold but do not leave the shiratama immersed for hours.

recipes.title: Tori Zosui — chicken, rice and egg soup in dashi broth
recipes.description: Tori Zosui (Riso Minestra, Pollo e Uovo in Brodo Dashi) develops the broth around cooked washed rice, chicken breast with strips and dishi broth flavored with soy sauce, added at different times to respect its cooking times. The preparation proceeds by layers, adjusting flavor and consistency while the liquid is enriched without causing the ingredients to fade. The main techniques are boiling and stewing; it takes about 20 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Barakamon, Gintama. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: flavored dashi broth with soy sauce

steps.instruction: If cooked rice is very starchy, rinse it quickly under cold water and drain it; this keeps the zosui lighter.
Cut the chicken into thin strips and bring the dashi to light boil with soy sauce and mirin.
Add the chicken and cook for about 4-5 minutes, removing any foam.
Combine the rice and simmer another 4-5 minutes, stirring just enough to not break the beans.
Beat the egg without making it completely homogeneous and flush it over the surface.
Turn off the fire, cover for about 1 minute and let the egg finish cooking with the residual heat.
Complete with onion and serve immediately, when the rice is soft but not yet fucked.

recipes.title: Uni Don — fresh sea urchin over rice
recipes.description: Uni Don (Ciotola di Rice con Ricci di Mare Freschi) uses fresh sea urchins (Uni) pulp, warm Sushi rice and fresh wasabi to build a plate of rice in which base and condiments retain separate identities. The elements that require cooking or cooling are prepared first, while the final assembly defines proportions and consistency. The recipe uses marinating, setting and boiling and takes about 15 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Golden Kamuy. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Use very fresh and keep it refrigerated until assembly; gently remove any excess liquid without crushing the gonads.
Prepare the Japanese rice, season it as indicated if you use sushi rice and let it warm up covered: it must be warm, not boiling.
Taste a small amount of uni before assembling the dish: it must have a clean sea scent, creamy texture and no ammoniacal notes.
Distribute rice into bowls without compressing it and add thin strips of nori.
Arrange the languages of one in one layer, handling them as little as possible to keep them intact.
Add a small amount of wasabi to the side, not directly on the whole hedgehog.
Serve the soy sauce separately or pour very little by thread only at the time of eating, so the delicate flavor of the uni remains the protagonist.

recipes.title: Choco Cornet — soft bread cones filled with chocolate
recipes.description: Choco Cornet (Panino Soft a Cono Farcito al Cioccolato) requires to manage separately dough and filling before assembly. brioche dough for Choco Cornet, thick chocolate cream and egg beaten to brush are the main references of a process that goes from mass development to forming and cooking, with cooling, leavening and dough. From the beginning to service it takes about 210 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Lucky Star, Sound! Euphonium. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Prepare the brioche dough with flour, milk, yeast, sugar, egg, salt and butter; mix until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise until doubling, usually 60-90 minutes depending on the temperature.
Meanwhile, prepare a thick chocolate cream, cool it completely and transfer it to a sac à poche.
Gently deflate the dough, divide it into portions and form long and regular cords.
Slightly grease the cone molds and wrap each spiral cord, just overlapping the spins without leaving cracks.
Leave the shaped croissants to stand for 20-30 minutes, then brush them with beaten egg.
Bake at 180°C for about 12-15 minutes, until they are uniformly golden; cool a few minutes and remove the moulds.
Let cool completely before filling with chocolate cream, so the filling does not melt.

recipes.title: Kushikatsu — Osaka-style crispy fried skewers
recipes.description: In Kushikatsu (Osaka's crunchy fried feet), pork, shrimp and onion are prepared so that the frying is quick and uniform. Pastel or breading enter only when the pieces are ready and the oil has reached the expected temperature; after cooking it drains and is completed immediately. The phases include frying, boiling and grilling or plate, for about 35 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Isekai Izakaya Nobu. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

steps.instruction: Cut pork, shrimp, onion and lotus root into similar pieces, small enough to cook at the same time, and put them separately on skewers.
Dry all the ingredients and flour slightly to favor the adhesion of the batter.
Prepare a fluid batter with flour, egg and cold water, without working too hard.
Pass every skewer into the batter and then into the panko, pressing just to create a uniform layer.
Bring the oil to 170-175°C and fry a few skewers at a time, adjusting the times according to the ingredient.
Drain on the grill and let stand for one minute; check that meat and shrimp are cooked in the middle.
Serve hot with kushikatsu sauce or tonkatsu separately, avoiding to leave the skewers immersed in the sauce.

recipes.title: Mizumochi / Raindrop Cake — clear water jelly
recipes.description: For Mizumochi / Raindrop Cake (Transparent Water Mochi), fixed low residue mineral water, agar-agar powder and sugar are transformed through a process in which temperature and consistency are decisive. The process clearly distinguishes preparation of the base, cooking or grip and stabilization phase, without shortening the rest. Boiling and cooling are provided, for about 270 minutes total.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars!, Demon Slayer. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: agar-agar powder
ingredients.note: The gelling force varies between brands: if the product indicates a different minimum dosage, follow the manufacturer's report while maintaining a very soft geling.

steps.instruction: Mix water, agar/kanten and any small amount of sugar in a saucepan before turning on the fire.
Heat by stirring until boiling and keep a slight boiling for as long as it takes to completely melt l'agar, usually a few minutes.
Turn off and briefly let the liquid rest to raise the bubbles, eliminating them with a spoon if necessary.
Pour into spherical molds or small cups without incorporating air.
Let cool and transfer to the refrigerator for at least 2-4 hours until the gelatin is fully stabilized.
Shape with great delicacy directly on the serving plate.
Add kinako and kuromitsu to the side only at the last moment and serve cold.

recipes.title: Apple and Cocoa Japanese Curry Stew
recipes.description: Curry Stuffed with Cocoa and Apple (Apple & Cocoa Curry) uses beef or cube pork, big red apple (grater) and bitter cocoa powder (or 2 squares of dark chocolate 70%) to obtain a well-bound and concentrated curry. The preparation starts from the aromatic elements, continues with longer cookings and regulates consistency and seasoning only in the finish. The sequence includes steam cooking, roasting and stewing and takes about 50 minutes overall.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Food Wars! (Shokugeki no Soma), Persona 5. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Bitter cocoa powder (or 2 squares of dark chocolate 70%)
roux nut for Japanese curry (or curry powder + flour)
steamed white rice (to serve)
ingredients.note: about 160 g of cooked rice per serving

steps.instruction: In a large pot, brown the onions with a little oil until they become well golden and caramelized.
Combine the meat with cubes and brown it on all sides.
Insert the carrots and potatoes.
Add the meat broth and the grated apple.
Cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 20 minutes.
Turn off the fire, join the roux for curry and amalgam until complete dissolution.
Combine the bitter cocoa powder (or dark chocolate), mix well and cook over very slow heat for another 5 minutes until you get a thick, shiny and aromatic sauce.
Bring to the hot table accompanied by white steamed rice.

recipes.title: Niku Soba — hot soba noodles with pork and leeks
recipes.description: The success of Niku Soba (Soba Calda con Maiale e Porri) depends on coordinating tagliolini Soba (buckwheat), belly or pork loin sliced thin and large leek (cut into 3 cm spools) without leaving the noodles waiting. The broth or seasoning is adjusted before cooking the pasta and the assembly takes place immediately after. Among the techniques used there are boiling and grilling or plate, distributed over about 25 minutes.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: very thin sliced pork belly or pork loin
Shichimi Togarashi (spice seven flavors, to garnish)

steps.instruction: In a non-stick pan without added fats, grill the leek spools until they are golden and toast them slightly on the surface, keep aside.
Put in a saucepan, boil the Dashi broth with soy sauce, mirin and sugar.
Combine the pork slices and let them cook for 3-4 minutes until they are tender.
Cook soba in plenty of boiling water for the time indicated on the package (about 3-4 minutes), drain and rinse briefly.
Divide the soba into two large bowls.
Add over the boiling broth with the pork slices and garnish with the grilled leek and a sprinkle of Shichimi Togarashi.

recipes.title: Ebi Tempura Udon — udon soup with shrimp tempura
recipes.description: Ebi Tempura Udon (Udon in broth with Shrimp Tempura) balances fresh or frozen Udon tagliolini, fresh shrimps (clean and peeled, keeping the tail) and flour for tempura (or flour 00 + ice water) in a bowl built for stages. Broil or seasoning are prepared first, the noodles remain separated until the right moment and the seals enter only in the final assembly. The main processes are frying, grill or plate and stewing, for about 35 minutes overall.
recipes.animeContext: This recipe is thematically inspired by Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan, Mob Psycho 100. These are editorial associations, not claims of appearances in specific episodes or chapters.

times.note: Total elapsed time includes the resting, proofing, marinating, cooling or freezing steps explicitly described in the method.

ingredients.name: Fresh prawns (clean and peeled, keeping tail)

steps.instruction: Clean the shrimp leaving the tail, remove the intestinal thread and practice small cuts on the belly to keep them straight in frying.
Prepare the broth by bringing dashi, light soy sauce and mirin to light sob; keep it warm without reducing it too much.
Mix tempura flour and ice water quickly, leaving a few small lumps and keeping the batter cold.
Take the oil to about 170°C, pass the shrimps into the batter and fry them a few at a time for about 2 minutes, until they are light and crispy.
Drain the tempura on the grid without covering it.
Cook the udon in separate water, drain well and distribute them in the bowls.
Pour the boiling broth on the udon and add onion.
It adapts the shrimps in tempura only at the time of serving, so the crust remains crunchy longer.

recipes.title: Hiyashi Tanuki Udon — chilled udon with crunchy tenkasu

Cook the udon in plenty of boiling water as long as they are elastic but still consistent.
Drain and cool immediately under very cold running water, then pass them in water and ice to stop completely cooking.

Distribute them in the bowls and add cucumber, egg, onion and nori.
Add tenkasu only at the last moment, so it remains crispy.
Pour the cold mentsuyu immediately before serving and mix at the table.

recipes.title: Katsu Curry Sando — breaded cutlet sandwich with curry sauce
recipes.description: Katsu Curry Sando (Sandwich with Cotoletta and Salsa Curry) requires to manage separately dough and filling before assembly. thick of Japanese sandwich bread (Shokupan), fried pork schnapps (Tonkatsu) crunchy and thick curry sauce (or Tonkatsu sauce mixed with little curry) are the main references of a process that goes from mass development to forming and cooking, with frying, baking and assembly. ingredients.name: thick curry sauce (or Tonkatsu sauce mixed with little curry)

steps.instruction: Keep ready the freshly fried or well heated tonkatsu cutlets, still crispy, and prepare the finely sliced cabbage.
Spread a thin veil of butter on the inside of the shokupan slices to create a barrier against moisture.
Season the cutlet with a thick curry sauce, avoiding excessive soaking of the breading.
Distribute the cabbage on the first slice of bread and place over the hot tonkatsu.
Close the sandwich, wrap it slightly with baking paper and press with a moderate weight for about 2 minutes.
Cut the crusts if you want a more traditional shape and cut the sandwich with a very sharp knife.
Serve immediately, when the bread is soft and the tonkatsu still preserves crunchiness.

recipes.title: Tori Chashu Ramen — ramen topped with marinated chicken
recipes.description: Tori Chashu Ramen (Ramen with Pollo Marinato) is a noodles recipe in which noodles for Ramen, bone-in chicken thighs with skin and soy sauce are managed separately to control sapidity and consistency. steps.instruction: Roll the chicken thigh with the skin on the outside and tie it tightly with kitchen spaghetti.
Put in a saucepan, brown the roll of chicken on all sides.
Combine soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, ginger and garlic.
Cover and cook over low heat for 15-20 minutes by turning the chicken from time to time until the sauce thickens and glazes the meat.
Let the chicken cool and slice it with gold discs.
Heat the chicken broth and adjust it to taste with 2 tablespoons of chicken cooking glaze.
Cook the noodles for ramen, drain them into the bowl, add the broth and garnish with the slices of Tori Chashu, marinated egg in half and onion.

recipes.title: Shirasu Don — rice bowl with tiny whitebait and egg
recipes.description: Shirasu Don (Riso Bowl with Bianchetti and Egg) organizes hot hot steamed Japanese rice, shirasu (bianchetti boiled or steamed) and fresh egg yolk on or together with rice only after each component is ready. steps.instruction: Prepare the Japanese rice and serve it hot, then let it rest a minute in the bowl to disperse the most intense steam.
Drain the shirasu well and check that there is no excess liquid; if they are very salty, taste them before adding more soy sauce.
Prepare the gaskets before assembly: grate the ginger, finely slice the onion and cut the nori into strips.
Distribute the whites evenly over the rice without compressing them.
Create a small hollow in the middle and gently lay the fresh yolk, using an egg suitable for raw consumption.
Add ginger, onion and nori in small separate quantities, so each bite can be adjusted as desired.
Pour the soy sauce flushed just before eating and partially mix the yolk with rice and shirasu, keeping different textures in the bowl.

recipes.title: Agedashi Nasu — fried eggplant marinated in dashi
recipes.description: For Agedashi Nasu (Melanzane Fritte Marinate in Brodo Dashi), eggplant beads or short Japanese, seed oil for frying and Dashi broth are processed in order to gradually build flavor and consistency. The procedure closes each phase before moving to the next, avoiding cooking or pre-cooked condiments that would change the result. steps.instruction: Cut the eggplant in half for the long and paste the skin with shallow diagonal cuts, so that they absorb the seasoning without flaking.
Dry them well and bring the oil to about 170°C.
Fry the eggplants for 3-4 minutes, turning them once, until the pulp is soft and the skin shiny.
Drain on grid or absorbent paper without crushing them.
Bring to simmer dashi, soy sauce and mirin for 1-2 minutes.
Place the eggplants still warm in a container and pour over the broth, leaving them to flavor at least 10 minutes.
Serve lukewarm or at room temperature with grated daikons and fresh ginger.

recipes.title: Tofu Dengaku — miso-glazed tofu skewers
recipes.description: For Tofu Dengaku (Tofu al Miso Feet), solid tofu (pressed and dried), red or white Miso and sugar are prepared before lighting the fire so as to control well gilding and dressing. The finishing sauce enters when the main part is almost ready and can adhere without drying. The sequence uses grid or plate, for a total of about 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Press the tofu to remove excess water, dry it and cut it into thick rectangles enough to be infiltrated without breaking.
Insert the skewers gently and pat the surface again.
Mix miso, sugar, mirin and sake in a saucepan and cook over low heat for about 2 minutes until the glaze is smooth and dense enough to stick.
Grill the tofu 2-3 minutes per side on a hot plate, until a slight gilding appears.
Brush a first time with miso sauce and let dry for about 30 seconds.
Add a second layer of glaze and pass under the grill for 1-2 minutes, checking continuously because the miso sugar burns easily.
Complete with toasted sesame and hot servi.

recipes.title: Sesame and Vegetable Yakiudon
recipes.description: In the Yakiudon al Sesamo and Verdure, fresh Udon, sliced cabbage and carrot stripes have different roles and are gathered only at the service. steps.instruction: Slow the udons in boiling water for about 1 minute, drain and separate them gently without breaking them.
Slice cabbage, carrot and onion into thin pieces and prepare the sauces before heating the wok.
Heat sesame oil over high heat and jump first onion and carrot for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cabbage and continue cooking for another 2 minutes, leaving the vegetables still slightly crispy.
Combine the udons and jump them on fire while they're warm.
Pour yakisoba/tonkatsu sauce and soy sauce along the warm edge of the wok and mix quickly to cover all noodles.
Serve immediately with katsuobushi, sesame or onion, avoiding to leave the udon firm in the pan.

recipes.title: Tonjiru — hearty pork, root vegetable and miso soup
recipes.description: Tonjiru (Rich Pig Soup, Roots and Miso) is a warm preparation based on finely sliced pork belly, Daikon root and crescent carrot and on an orderly cooking of the ingredients. steps.instruction: Cut pork belly, daikon and carrot into thin pieces and prepare the cube tofu.
Heat sesame oil in a saucepan and brown the pig until it changes color and releases part of the fat.
Add daikon and carrot and salt them for about 2 minutes to flavor them in the bottom.
Pour the dashi, bring to light boil and remove any foam.
Cover and cook over medium to low heat for about 10 minutes until the roots become tender.
Add the tofu and heat it for 2-3 minutes without stirring vigorously.
Turn off the fire, melt the miso in a ladle of broth and incorporate it to the soup without bringing it back to the boil.
Complete with onion and serve very hot.

recipes.title: Kabocha no Nimono — simmered Japanese pumpkin
recipes.description: For Kabocha no Nimono (Japanese Zucca Stufata), pumpkin Kabocha (or pumpkin Delica with the skin), Dashi broth and sugar are processed in order to gradually build flavor and consistency. ingredients.name: pumpkin Kabocha (or pumpkin Delica with skin)

steps.instruction: Cut the pumpkin into regular touches of 3-4 cm leaving the skin (peel only slightly the edges so as not to undo it).
Place the pumpkin touches in one layer in a small pan with the skin pointing downwards.
Combine Dashi, sugar and mirin.
Bring to a boil, cover with an inner lid (Otoshibuta or punched oven paper) and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, cover again and cook on a sweet heat for another 8-10 minutes until the pumpkin becomes soft and the sauce is reduced.
Let it warm before serving so that it absorbs all flavors.

recipes.title: Matcha Mille-Crêpe Cake — layered green tea crêpe cake
recipes.description: Matcha Mille Crepe Cake (Torta Millefoglie di Crepes al Tea Verde) starts from flour 00, Matcha powder and sugar and builds its consistency through successive steps instead of a simple mixing. steps.instruction: Slice flour and Matcha in a bowl.
Add sugar and eggs, then add warm milk and melted butter by mixing with a whisk until you get a liquid batter without lumps.
Rest in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Cook about 15-20 thin crepes in a lightly buttered non-stick pan, let them cool completely.
Mount the cream with the icing sugar and Matcha, then incorporate it with the pastry cream.
Assemble the dessert by placing the first crack on a plate, spread a thin layer of cream and cover with another crack.
Repeat until the ingredients are exhausted.
Dust the surface with Matcha powder before serving cold from the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Kurogoma Pudding — black sesame pudding
recipes.description: For Kurogoma Pudding (Budino al Sesamo Nero), black sesame paste (Neri Goma), whole milk and fresh cream are transformed through a process in which temperature and consistency are decisive. steps.instruction: Put the gelatin in very cold water for about 10 minutes until it is completely soft.
Mix milk, cream, sugar and black sesame paste in a saucepan.
Heat over low heat by mixing with the whip until the mixture is uniform and the sugar is dissolved, without boiling.
Remove from the heat, squeeze the gelatin well and incorporate it until it is completely dissolved.
Filter the mixture through a fine strainer to remove any residues and obtain a smoother texture.
Pour in the glasses, let cool and transfer to the refrigerator for at least 3 hours.
Garnish with little whipped cream and toasted black sesame only at the time of service.

recipes.title: Matcha Daifuku with Anko — green tea rice cakes
recipes.description: The preparation of Matcha Daifuku with Anko revolves around glutinous rice flour (Mochiko/Shiratamako), water and sugar and to the precise management of the cake structure. ingredients.name: Anko red bean paste (divided into 6 balls)

steps.instruction: Divide the anko into six equal balls and keep them covered; dust the work surface with corn starch or starch.
Mix glutinous rice flour, sugar, matcha and water in a microwave bowl until dry lumps remain.
Cover leaving a vent and bake at 600 W for about 90 seconds.
Mix with a wet spatula and cook about 60 seconds, until the dough is shiny, elastic and evenly cooked.
Transfer immediately the hot mass to the dusted surface, cover it with other starch and let it warm enough to handle it.
Divide into six portions, flatten them into discs and thinn the edges slightly.
Put a ball of anko in the center, close the edges pinching them well and place the daifuku with the closing down.
Remove excess starch and serve at room temperature the same day.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Tartlets — fresh fruit mini tarts

steps.instruction: Dress the buttered molds with the short pastry, trim the edges and hole the bottom with a fork.
Cools the shells formed for 15-20 minutes before cooking, so they keep the shape better.
Bake in white at 180°C for about 15-20 minutes until they are uniformly golden.
Shape and let cool completely on a grid.
Fill each cold shell with cold pastry cream, leveling it without crossing the edge.
Cut the fruit just before use, dry it and stock it in a compact way on the cream.
Brush with a veil of neutral gelatin to polish and protect the fruit.
Keep cool and serve in the day to keep the crisp short.

recipes.title: Soufflé Cheese Tarts — fluffy cheese tartlets

egg (separate egg yolks and egg whites)

steps.instruction: Bring the stuffing ingredients to room temperature and prepare the already cooked and completely cold short shells.
Work cream cheese, butter, yolk, half the sugar, cream, starch and lemon juice until you get a smooth cream.
Add the remaining sugar gradually, stopping at a shiny meringue with soft peaks.
It incorporates the cream meringue in two shots, with delicate movements from the bottom to the top.
Fill the shells creating a small dome and smooth the surface.
Brush with little yolk or milk if you want a more intense gilding.
Bake at 200°C for about 10-12 minutes, until the surface is golden but the center remains soft.
Allow to warm a few minutes before serving, avoiding to cook them beyond the point where the filling loses creaminess.

recipes.title: Sata Andagi — traditional Okinawan sweet fritters

steps.instruction: Slice flour and yeast and keep them aside.
Beat eggs, sugar and the oil in the dough until the sugar is almost dissolved.
Embed dry ingredients with a spatula until you get a very thick and sticky dough; do not work it any more than you need.
Plenty of oil at about 150-160°C: a moderate temperature allows pancakes to cook inside before darkening.
Slightly grease your hands and form balls of the size of a walnut without compressing them too much.
Fry a few pieces at a time for 6-8 minutes, turning them often, until the cracks appear and the surface is well golden.
Drain on a grid or absorbent paper and let cool a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Maguro Don — fresh tuna and wasabi over rice
recipes.description: In Maguro Don (Riso Ciotola con Tonno Rosso Fresco e Wasabi), rice is based on bluefin tuna fillet for sushi (sashimi quality), sushi rice (Japonic Rice) and rice vinegar, prepared with different times before being assembled. ingredients.name: bluefin tuna fillet for sushi (sashimi quality)
Alga nori cut into thin strips

steps.instruction: Rinse the sushi rice thoroughly under running cold water until the water is clear.
Cook the rice over low heat with lid for 12 minutes.
Put in a saucepan, dissolve sugar and salt in rice vinegar by heating slightly.
Combine the vinegar mixture with warm rice by gently rubbing it with a wooden spatula and let it cool.
With a sharp knife for sashimi, cut the bluefin tuna fillet into about 7-8 mm thick slices, tilting the blade to 45 degrees to obtain regular slices.
In a bowl, mix the soy sauce with the mirin.
Quickly pass the tuna slices into the marinade for 1-2 minutes.
Put the hot sushi rice in Donburi's bowls.
Sprinkle the surface with the alga Nori in strips.
Arrange the slices of ray tuna covering entirely the rice.
Decorate in the middle with a curl of wasabi, chopped chives and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve immediately with extra soy sauce.

recipes.title: Kurogoma Ramen — rich black sesame broth ramen
recipes.description: The success of Kurogoma Ramen (Ramen with the Denso Brod of Sesamo Nero) depends on coordinating fresh noodles for ramen, black sesame paste (Kurogoma Paste) and black sesame toasted beaten to the mortar without leaving the noodles waiting. steps.instruction: In a pan heats sesame oil and fry garlic and ginger.
Add the ground pork and brown until crispy.
Taste with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and TobanDjan.
In a mortar or bowl, emulsify the black sesame paste with toasted sesame, 1 tablespoon soy sauce and a ladle of hot broth until you get a smooth cream.
Heat the remaining chicken broth and combine the base with black sesame, mixing vigorously with a whisk to distribute sesame evenly.
Cook the noodles for ramen in plenty of unsalted boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
Add the black broth and scented in the bowls, place the noodles in the center.
Place the browned pork on top, the marinated eggs split in half, soy sprouts and abundant onion.

recipes.title: Ika no Sugatayaki — whole grilled squid with teriyaki sauce
recipes.description: In Ika no Sugatayaki (Calamaro Entire Grilled with Teriyaki Sauce), clean whole squid with tentacles, soy sauce and mirin are worked carefully to the surface: first the main part is prepared, then the seasoning is concentrated without exceeding with heat. ingredients.name: fresh whole squids cleaned with tentacles

steps.instruction: Wash and dry the squid thoroughly.
Practice on the body of the squid parallel horizontal cuts spaced about 1 cm, without engraving to the bottom, so the cooking will remain uniform.
In a saucepan, add soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar and grated ginger.
Cook over low heat for 3-4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Warm up a hot plate or a steak pan over a high heat.
Grill the squids and tentacles for 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush the squid thoroughly with Teriyaki sauce in the last 2 minutes of cooking, turning them until the surface is shiny and caramelized.
Cut the squid into slices following the incisions already practised.
Serve with Kewpie mayonnaise separately and a sprinkle of Shichimi Togarashi.

recipes.title: Kani Chahan — crab and leek fried rice

ingredients.name: rice cooked the day before (cold refrigerator)

steps.instruction: Stretch the cold rice well with your hands to separate the grains.
Heat a wok on a lively fire with sesame oil.
Suffer garlic and half the onion.
Add beaten eggs and mix quickly to create soft scrambles.
Immediately add the rice into the wok and sauté it over a strong heat for 3-4 minutes, constantly stretching with the spatula.
Add the dried crab pulp and mix gently to mix without overly staggering the pulp.
Add the soy sauce along the browned edge of the wok to make it caramelize before incorporating it to rice.
Salt rule and abundant white pepper.
Combine the rest of the fresh onion and serve well warm.

recipes.title: Kamo Namban Soba — hot soba noodles with duck and toasted leeks
recipes.description: The success of Kamo Namban Soba (Soba Hot in broth with Duck and Toasted Porri) depends on coordinating tagliolini Buckwheat soba, duck breast with Japanese skin and long leeks (Naganegi) cut into 4 cm tochets without leaving the noodles waiting. Cook in a cold non-stick pan from the side of the skin over medium to low heat for 8-10 minutes by collecting the melted fat.
Turn the duck breast and cook for another 2 minutes.
Let the meat rest for a few minutes, then cut into thin slices.
In the same pan, using part of the duck's fat, it toasts leek touches until they are well golden and slightly caramelized.
In a pot, add dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar.
Bring the broth to a boil, add the toasted leeks and slices of duck and let simmer for 2 minutes.
Cook the noodles soba in boiling water for about 4 minutes; drain them, rinse them under cold water to remove the surface starch and heat them briefly in hot water before serving.
Distribute the soba in the bowls and cover it with hot broth, duck slices and leeks.
Complete with grated yuzu zest and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chashu Bun — steamed buns stuffed with braised pork
recipes.description: Chashu Bun (Panino al Vapore Farcito con Maiale Brasato) requires to manage separately dough and filling before assembly. type 00 flour, dry beer yeast and sugar are the main references of a process that goes from mass development to forming and cooking, with baking, steam cooking and leavening. ingredients.name: Chashu pig (braised pork belly) passed into a pan

steps.instruction: Melt the yeast and sugar in warm water.
In a bowl, add flour, salt, oil and liquid.
Knead for about 10 minutes until you get a smooth and elastic pan.
Let rise for 1 hour until doubling.
Roll out the dough at about 1 cm thick and make 4 oval discs.
Brush the surface with little oil and fold each disc in half, shaped like a shell, inserting a piece of paper oven inside to prevent it from being sold.
Leave the sandwiches to rest for 15 minutes, then cook in the steam basket for about 12 minutes on medium heat.
Gently open the hot sandwiches, remove the inside baking paper.
Make with Chashu slices well frosted with its sauce, slices of fresh cucumber, onion and a thread of mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Yaki Curry — baked curry gratin with cheese and egg
recipes.description: Yaki Curry (Curry with Cheese and Egg) uses steamed white rice, dense Japanese curry already ready with meat and potatoes to obtain a well-bound and concentrated curry. ingredients.name: dense Japanese curry already ready with meat

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 200°C and lightly burn two heat-resistant single portion pyrophiles.

Create a hollow in the middle of each baking dish and gently break an egg inside.
Distribute the cheese around the egg and complete with a thin sprinkle of panko.
Bake for about 10-12 minutes, until the cheese is melted and golden and the album is reprised.
Check the yolk according to the desired result: to keep it soft avoids unnecessary extension of cooking.
Complete with parsley and serve immediately in the baking dish, paying attention to the temperature of the container.

Bountifully brushed with Tare sauce in the last few minutes, turning them often.

Add daikon, carrot and shiitake and jump for about 3 minutes.
Pour the kombu dashi, bring to light boil and cook covered for about 8-10 minutes, until the roots are tender.
Season with soy sauce and mirin and taste the broth before adding more salt.
Cook the udon in a separate pot for the required time, drain well and distribute them in the bowls.
Pour over the soup with tofu and vegetables.

recipes.description: The preparation of Buri Daikon (Ricciola Stufata con Radice di Daikon) revolves around slices of fresh Ricciola (Buri), Daikon root peeled and cut into discs of 2 cm and Dashi and to the control of their consistency. Brings to a boil, feeds the Daikon and the fish.

Combine the soy sauce in the last 10 minutes by reducing the liquid until dense and shiny.

steps.instruction: Put the clams in a pot with the sake and the chopped garlic.
Cover with lid and cook over a high heat for 3-4 minutes until the clams open.
Carefully filter the liquid released from clams and keep it aside together with open molluscs.
Add the clam juice to the Dashi broth, add the light soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
Heat well the clam broth without overly reducing it.
Cook the noodles for ramen in plenty of boiling water for 2 minutes and drain.
Distribute the noodles in the bowls and cover them with the hot broth to the clams.
Adage over the clams in the shell, the corn and the fresh onion; complete with a nut of butter, which melting will bind the seafood stock.

recipes.description: Nasu Dengaku (Miso Dolce Toasted Glazed Eggplant) enhances medium or short Japanese round eggplant, white miso paste (Shiro Miso) and mirin with a cooking that concentrates the surface and keeps the inside to the expected consistency. steps.instruction: Cut the eggplants in half in the direction of length.
Slice the grilled pulp without piercing the skin.
Heat the oil in a large pan.
Cook the eggplants on the side of the flesh over medium heat for 5 minutes until golden.
Turn the eggplant, cover and continue cooking for another 4 minutes, until the pulp is soft.
In a saucepan, mix miso, mirin, sake and sugar over low heat for 2 minutes until you get a smooth and dense glaze.
Generously brush the flesh of the eggplant with miso frosting.
Transfer the eggplants under the oven grill at 220°C for 3-4 minutes, until the glaze forms bubbles and candy slightly.
Complete with toasted sesame seeds and serve hot eggplants.

recipes.description: For Matcha Chiffon Cake (Torta Softe e Alta al Tea Verde Matcha), egg (albumi and egg yolks separated), quality Matcha cake flour and tea powder are transformed through a processing in which temperature and consistency are determining. Combine seed oil and warm water while stirring.
Slice the flour together with Matcha tea and embed the egg yolks with a whisk.
In another well-cleaned bowl, mount the egg whites with the cream tartaro and the remaining sugar added in 3 shots, until you get a well firm and shiny meringue.
Incorporate one third of the meringue into the compound to the matcha to make it more fluid, then gently combine the remaining meringue with movements from the bottom up.
Pour the dough into the non-burred chiffon cake mold and gently level the surface.
Cook in a static oven at 160°C for 30 minutes.
Bake and turn the mold immediately on a bottle or on the appropriate support; let cool completely before deforming.

steps.instruction: In a bowl, mix the condensed milk with the egg yolk.
Sift the flour with the yeast and add it to the mixture, kneading until you get a soft bread.
Leave in the fridge for 20 minutes.
Wrap each whole chestnut with 20g of Shiro-an paste creating a regular ball.
Divide the dough into 8 portions, roll out the disc and wrap the chestnut balls and Shiro-an by sealing well the edges and giving a chestnut shape.
Place on a baking tray with baking paper.
Mix the yolk with the soy sauce and brush only the top of the manju.
Dip the tip in the black sesame seeds.
Bake in a ventilated oven at 170°C for 12-15 minutes until the dome is well golden and shiny.

recipes.title: Yuzu Sorbet — refreshing Japanese citrus sorbet
recipes.description: The preparation of Yuzu Sorbet (Sorbet Refreshing to citrus Yuzu) revolves around fresh or 100% pure Yuzu juice bottled, water and sugar and to the precise management of the cake structure. The process separates the phases that develop volume, cooking or taking from those of rest and finish. The processes include cooling, freezing and frame; the total time, including waiting, is about 300 minutes.

steps.instruction: In a saucepan, heat the water with sugar and lemon peel until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Let the syrup cool at room temperature.
Embed Yuzu's juice into cold syrup and mix thoroughly.
Add the mixture in a low steel container and put in a freezer.
After 1 hour, when it begins to firm at the edges, it snows the egg white and incorporates it to the sorbet with a whip to make it foamy.
Put in the freezer for another 3 hours, mixing vigorously with a fork every 45 minutes to break the ice crystals.
Serve in iced cups decorated with mint leaves or citrus slices.
